method: Editorially revised bilingual dialogue, aligned with relevant SMCP concepts; not a verbatim IMO publication.

pairs.title: 问候和介绍
pairs.en: Good morning! Welcome aboard! I am Captain Wang. What's your name, and what position are you joining us as?
pairs.zh: 早上好！欢迎登船！我是王船长。你叫什么名字，担任什么职位加入我们？

pairs.title: 问候和介绍
pairs.en: Hello, Captain Wang. My name is Jack, and I am joining the vessel as a deckhand. I am pleased to join you. I have worked on cargo ships for three years and am familiar with deck operations.
pairs.zh: 王船长，您好。我叫Jack，将在本船担任甲板水手，很高兴加入大家。我有三年货船工作经验，熟悉甲板作业。

pairs.title: 问候和介绍
pairs.en: Nice to meet you, JACK! It's great to have you on board. You'll be responsible for assisting with the daily operations and maintenance of the deck and equipment. Also, you need to follow the watch schedule strictly and cooperate with other crew members.
pairs.zh: 很高兴认识你，JACK！欢迎你的加入。你主要负责协助甲板及设备的日常操作和维护，同时要严格遵守值班表，配合其他船员工作。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 问候和介绍
pairs.en: Thank you, Captain. I'm looking forward to meeting everyone and getting started. I will do my best to fulfill my duties and adapt to the ship's life quickly.
pairs.zh: 谢谢船长。我期待和大家见面并投入工作，我会尽力履行职责，快速适应船上生活。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 问候和介绍
pairs.en: You're welcome. If you have any questions during your work, don't hesitate to ask your seniors or me.
pairs.zh: 不客气。工作中有任何疑问，随时可以请教前辈或我。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 引航员登船
pairs.en: Good morning, Captain. This is Pilot ANDY. I'll be onboard at 10 AM for departure. The port traffic is busy today, so we need to follow the planned route strictly.
pairs.zh: 早上好，船长。我是引航员 ANDY，上午 10 点登船引导离港。今日港口交通繁忙，我们需严格按照规划航线行驶。

pairs.title: 引航员登船
pairs.en: Good morning, Pilot Andy. All unberthing preparations are complete. The main engine and navigation equipment have been tested twice this morning.
pairs.zh: 早上好，Andy引航员。离泊准备已全部完成，今早已对主机和航行设备进行两次测试。

pairs.title: 引航员登船
pairs.en: Have you reviewed the passage plan and the latest weather forecast? The wind is expected to reach force 6 this afternoon. We need to adjust our speed as appropriate.
pairs.zh: 你查看过航次计划和最新天气预报吗？预计下午风力将达6级，我们需要适当调整航速。

pairs.title: 引航员登船
pairs.en: Sure. All systems have been checked based on the latest data. We've marked the shallow water area on the chart to avoid risks.
pairs.zh: 已查看，所有系统均按最新数据检查完毕。我们已在海图标注浅水区，规避航行风险。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 引航员登船
pairs.en: I will check the passage plan and equipment with you after boarding. We expect to get underway shortly. Keep the working channel clear.
pairs.zh: 登船后，我会和你一起核对航次计划及设备。我们预计很快开航，请保持工作频道畅通。

pairs.title: 引航员登船
pairs.en: Understood. Our crew is standing by to assist you. Safe travels ahead, Pilot. We'll keep you informed of any changes on board.
pairs.zh: 明白。船员随时待命协助您，引航员，祝您航行顺利。船上如有变动，我们会及时告知您。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 引航员登船
pairs.en: Thank you, Captain. See you on deck.
pairs.zh: 谢谢船长，甲板见。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 接待访客
pairs.en: Welcome aboard, sir. May I see your boarding pass and ID card for verification?
pairs.zh: 欢迎登船，先生。请出示登船许可和身份证件，以便核验。

pairs.title: 接待访客
pairs.en: Here you go. I'm from the port inspection bureau, here to conduct a routine safety check.
pairs.zh: 给你。我是港口检验局工作人员，前来进行常规安全检查。

pairs.title: 接待访客
pairs.en: Thank you. The captain is waiting for your arrival in his room. Please follow me. I'll also arrange a crew member to accompany you during the inspection.
pairs.zh: 谢谢。船长正在房间等候，请随我来。我会安排一名船员全程陪同您检查。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 接待访客
pairs.en: Thank you. Is there anything that may affect the inspection? I have another vessel to inspect this afternoon.
pairs.zh: 谢谢。有什么情况可能影响检查进度吗？我下午还要检查另一艘船。

pairs.title: 接待访客
pairs.en: It depends on the situation, usually about one to two hours. We've prepared all relevant documents for you in advance.
pairs.zh: 视情况而定，通常 1-2 小时。我们已提前备好所有相关文件。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 接待访客
pairs.en: That's very thoughtful.
pairs.zh: 考虑得很周到。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 接待访客
pairs.en: Enjoy your stay. If you need any help during your visit, please feel free to tell me.
pairs.zh: 祝您在船一切顺利。访问期间如有任何需求，随时告知我。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: ANDY, there's thick smoke coming from the No.2 cargo hold! Sound the fire alarm immediately and notify all crew members!
pairs.zh: ANDY，2 号货舱冒出浓烟！立即拉响火警，通知全体船员！

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: Yes, Captain! Fire alarm, fire alarm! All crew, assemble at the emergency station right now!
pairs.zh: 收到，船长！火警，火警！全体船员，立即到应急集合点集合！

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: All crew members, this is the captain speaking. Evacuate the affected area immediately. Follow the emergency procedures and head to the lifeboats with your lifejackets.
pairs.zh: 全体船员，我是船长。立即撤离受影响区域，遵循应急程序，穿戴救生衣前往救生艇处。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: Captain, the fire fighting team has arrived at the scene and started spraying foam. Lifeboats are being prepared. Shall we start lowering them?
pairs.zh: 船长，消防小组已抵达现场，开始喷射泡沫灭火。救生艇正在准备，是否开始下放？
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: Yes, start lowering the lifeboats one by one. Ensure everyone wears their lifejackets correctly. Make sure we account for all crew members before leaving the ship.
pairs.zh: 是的，依次下放救生艇。确保所有人正确穿戴救生衣，离船前务必清点所有船员人数。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: Understood, Captain. All crew members are accounted for and boarding the lifeboats now. No one is left behind.
pairs.zh: 明白，船长。所有船员已清点完毕，正在登上救生艇，无人员遗漏。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: Ok. Inform the coast guard about our situation and request immediate assistance. Report the fire location and ship details clearly.
pairs.zh: 好的。向海岸警卫队通报情况，请求紧急援助，清晰说明失火位置和船舶信息。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: Coast guard has been informed, Captain. They're sending a rescue team and fire boats our way, expected to arrive in 20 minutes.
pairs.zh: 船长，已通知海岸警卫队，他们正派遣救援队和消防船赶来，预计 20 分钟抵达。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 消防和救生
pairs.en: Stay calm, everyone. We'll get through this together. Keep communication open and follow all instructions.
pairs.zh: 大家保持冷静，我们会共渡难关。保持通讯畅通，严格遵守指令。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 船舶修理与保养
pairs.en: What's the maintenance issue on the deck today, JACK? List all the problems clearly.
pairs.zh: JACK，今日甲板有哪些维修保养问题？清晰列出所有故障。

pairs.title: 船舶修理与保养
pairs.en: The anchor chain is severely worn and some links are deformed. It needs immediate replacement. There are also rust patches on the starboard side of the hull.
pairs.zh: 锚链严重磨损，部分链节变形，需要立即更换。右舷船体也有锈斑。

pairs.title: 船舶修理与保养
pairs.en: Okay, note down the specifications of the new anchor chain and report to the chief officer. And check the bilge pumps for slowness or abnormal noise.
pairs.zh: 好的，记录新锚链的规格并上报大副。另外检查舱底泵是否运转缓慢或有异常噪音。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 船舶修理与保养
pairs.en: The bilge pumps operated slowly yesterday. I will check the pipelines for blockages. Shall we paint the hull after removing the rust?
pairs.zh: 昨天舱底泵运转缓慢。我会检查管路是否堵塞。船体除锈后是否刷漆？

pairs.title: 船舶修理与保养
pairs.en: Yes, arrange the anti-rust paint, brushes and other supplies. Finish the rust removal and painting work this week before the heavy rain comes.
pairs.zh: 是的，备好防锈漆、刷子等物料，本周大雨来临前完成除锈刷漆工作。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 船舶修理与保养
pairs.en: Understood. I'll organize the crew to divide the work and finish promptly. We'll also clean the deck and remove all sundries by the way.
pairs.zh: 明白。我会组织船员分工协作，尽快完工，顺便清理甲板、清除杂物。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 船舶修理与保养
pairs.en: Good. Pay attention to safety when working at height. Wear safety harnesses and set up warning signs around the working area.
pairs.zh: 很好。高空作业注意安全，系好安全带，作业区域周围设置警示标识。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Andy, would you like to play table tennis later? We have been busy and need to relax.
pairs.zh: Andy，待会儿要不要打乒乓球？最近工作忙，需要放松一下。

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Oh, that sounds great! I've been wanting to play for a long time. When were you thinking?
pairs.zh: 好呀！我早就想打了，你想什么时候去？

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: How about after lunch, around 1 o'clock? The playroom should be empty then, no one will disturb us.
pairs.zh: 午饭后 1 点左右怎么样？那时候娱乐室没人，不会被打扰。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Good idea. I'll bring the rackets; I've got a couple of new ones we can try out. They're very light and comfortable to hold.
pairs.zh: 好主意。我带球拍，我有两个新球拍，很轻、握着舒服，咱们试试。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Awesome, I'll grab some new balls. How about we play best of three sets to make it interesting? Loser has to do the cleaning of the playroom tomorrow.
pairs.zh: 太棒了，我去拿新球。咱们打三局两胜制，增加点趣味，输的人明天打扫娱乐室怎么样？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Sounds perfect. How about we put a little bet on it? Loser buys the winner a cold drink from the fridge.
pairs.zh: 没问题。咱们再赌一把？输的人给赢的人买杯冰箱里的冷饮。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Hmm, how about this – winner gets an extra scoop of ice cream at dinner and a can of soda.
pairs.zh: 不如这样，赢的人晚餐多一勺冰淇淋，再加一罐汽水。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Deal! We'll meet at 1 PM, sharp? Don't be late.
pairs.zh: 一言为定！下午 1 点整见面，别迟到。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: Certainly. I will be on time. I will finish lunch early and wait for you there.
pairs.zh: 当然。我会准时到，早点吃完午饭在那里等你。

pairs.title: 在船运动和娱乐
pairs.en: See you, can't wait! Should be a good match. Let's have fun.
pairs.zh: 到时候见，太期待了！肯定很精彩，好好玩一场。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station from the port? I need to go to the city center to buy some daily necessities.
pairs.zh: 打扰一下，能告诉我从港口怎么去最近的地铁站吗？我要去市中心买些日用品。

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: Go straight ahead for about 500 metres and turn left at the second junction. The subway station is a five-minute walk from that junction.
pairs.zh: 向前直走约500米，在第二个路口左转。从那个路口步行五分钟就到地铁站。

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: Is it far from here after turning left? And which subway line should I take?
pairs.zh: 左转后还远吗？要坐几号线地铁？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: No, it's just a five-minute walk from the crossing. Take Line 3, it goes directly to the city center. The station name is Central Station.
pairs.zh: 不远，从路口步行 5 分钟就到。坐 3 号线，直达市中心，站名是中央站。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: That's convenient. Are there any shopping malls near the subway station?
pairs.zh: 太方便了。地铁站附近有商场吗？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: Yes, there's a large shopping mall next to the station, you can buy everything you need there.
pairs.zh: 有，旁边就有个大型商场，你需要的东西都能买到。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: Thank you very much for your detailed guidance.
pairs.zh: 非常感谢你详细的指引。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 问路
pairs.en: You're welcome! If you get lost, you can ask the local people, they're very friendly. Have a nice trip!
pairs.zh: 不客气！迷路了可以问当地人，他们很友好。祝你出行顺利！
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: What's wrong with you? How do you feel these days?
pairs.zh: 你哪里不舒服？这几天感觉怎么样？

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: I feel a little dizzy and have a headache. I also feel tired and can't sleep well at night.
pairs.zh: 有点头晕、头痛，还总觉得累，晚上睡不好。

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: How long have you been like this? Do you have any other symptoms, like nausea or sore throat?
pairs.zh: 这样多久了？还有其他症状吗？比如恶心、喉咙痛？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: Two days. Sometimes I feel a little nauseous, but no sore throat. I've been working overtime these days, maybe I'm too tired.
pairs.zh: 两天了，偶尔有点恶心，喉咙不痛。这几天加班多，可能太累了。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: I will take your temperature and blood pressure and seek medical advice. Treatment will depend on the medical assessment.
pairs.zh: 我会测量你的体温和血压，并寻求医疗建议。治疗应根据医疗评估决定。

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: How to take the medicine? Are there any side effects?
pairs.zh: 药怎么吃？有副作用吗？
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: Follow the instructions for any prescribed medicine. Confirm the name, dose, frequency and possible side effects with the medical professional.
pairs.zh: 如有处方药，请遵照医嘱使用，并向医务人员确认药名、剂量、服用频次及可能的副作用。

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: How soon can I get well? I need to go back to work soon.
pairs.zh: 多久能好？我还要尽快回去工作。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: Rest and avoid strenuous work until you have received medical advice about returning to duty.
pairs.zh: 先休息，避免繁重工作，并就何时恢复值班征求医疗意见。

pairs.title: 看医生
pairs.en: Thank you, doctor. I'll follow your advice.
pairs.zh: 谢谢医生，我会听你的建议。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: Excuse me, could you recommend a good place for shopping around here? I want to buy some local specialties and souvenirs.
pairs.zh: 打扰一下，能推荐附近靠谱的购物地吗？我想买点当地特产和纪念品。

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: Sure, the main shopping mall is just down the street, about 10 minutes' walk. There are various items, including local snacks, handicrafts and clothes.
pairs.zh: 当然，主购物中心就在这条街尽头，步行 10 分钟，里面有各种商品，包括本地小吃、手工艺品和服饰。

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: That's perfect. Do you also know where the nearest tourist attraction is? I want to take some photos after shopping.
pairs.zh: 太好了。知道最近的景点在哪吗？购物后想去拍拍照。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: The coastal landmark is on the other side of the central park. The view from the top is excellent, especially at sunset.
pairs.zh: 海岸地标在中央公园另一侧，从上面看景色很好，尤其是日落时。

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: Sounds exciting. How can I get there from the shopping mall?
pairs.zh: 太心动了。从商场怎么过去？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: You can take the subway, it's just two stops away. Or you can walk along the seaside, it takes about 20 minutes and the scenery is beautiful.
pairs.zh: 坐地铁两站就到，也可以沿海边步行 20 分钟，沿途风景超美。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: I prefer walking. Are there any restaurants near the attraction? I want to try local food.
pairs.zh: 我更喜欢步行。景点附近有餐厅吗？想尝尝当地美食。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: Yes, there are many seafood restaurants nearby, the food is fresh and delicious.
pairs.zh: 有，附近有很多海鲜餐厅，食材新鲜，味道可口。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: Thank you so much for your help!
pairs.zh: 太感谢你的帮忙了！
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 国外购物与观光
pairs.en: You're welcome! Enjoy your trip and have a good time!
pairs.zh: 不客气！祝你旅途愉快，玩得开心！
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: Passport and seaman's book, please. Also, provide the crew list and ship's registration certificate.
pairs.zh: 请出示护照、船员证，同时提供船员名单和船舶登记证书。

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: Here you are. I am the Chief Engineer of M/V Blue Whale. The documents are complete and valid.
pairs.zh: 给您。我是Blue Whale轮的轮机长，证件齐全且有效。

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: What's your last port of call and next destination? How long will you stay at this port?
pairs.zh: 上一个停靠港和下一个目的港是哪里？在本港停留多久？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: Singapore. Our next destination is Rotterdam. We'll stay here for three days to load cargo and refuel.
pairs.zh: 上港是新加坡，下港是鹿特丹。在此停留 3 天，装货、补充燃油。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: Any restricted items to declare, such as tobacco, alcohol or controlled goods?
pairs.zh: 有烟草、酒类或管制物品等限制品需要申报吗？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: Only crew personal effects. There are no restricted or prohibited items. We have completed the declaration accurately.
pairs.zh: 只有船员个人物品，没有限制品或违禁品。我们已如实填写申报表。

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: Has anyone had fever, cough or other unusual symptoms in the past 48 hours? Have all crewmembers completed the health check?
pairs.zh: 过去48小时内，有人出现发热、咳嗽或其他异常症状吗？所有船员都完成健康检查了吗？

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: No, all crew are healthy. Here's our health declaration and vaccination certificate.
pairs.zh: 没有，全体船员身体健康。这是健康声明和疫苗接种证明。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: The document check is complete. You may proceed with the remaining formalities.
pairs.zh: 证件查验已经完成，可以办理其余手续。

pairs.title: 出入境
pairs.en: Thank you very much.
pairs.zh: 非常感谢。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: What are the present weather and sea conditions? Are there any unusual situations around the vessel?
pairs.zh: 目前天气和海况如何？本船周围有异常情况吗？

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: Good evening, sir. The weather is clear, wind force 3, sea state calm. No other ships or obstacles within 5 nautical miles.
pairs.zh: 晚上好，长官。天气晴朗，风力 3 级，海面平静。5 海里内无其他船舶和障碍物。

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: Very good. Check the navigation lights and radar equipment regularly. Report immediately if there's any fault.
pairs.zh: 很好。定期检查航行灯和雷达设备，如有故障立即上报。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: Yes, sir. The navigation lights are normal, radar is working stably. I'll check them every 30 minutes.
pairs.zh: 收到，长官。航行灯正常，雷达运行稳定，我每 30 分钟检查一次。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: Have the course or speed changed? Monitor any course deviation.
pairs.zh: 航向或航速有变化吗？注意监控航向偏差。

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: No change, current course is 120°, speed is 15 knots. No obvious deviation found.
pairs.zh: 无变动，当前航向 120 度，航速 15 节，未发现明显偏移。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: Alright. Keep a close watch and maintain communication. Wake me up if anything urgent happens.
pairs.zh: 好的。加强瞭望，保持通讯畅通，有紧急情况立即叫醒我。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 日常值班沟通
pairs.en: Understood, sir. I'll stay alert all the time.
pairs.zh: 明白，长官。我会全程保持警惕。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: Good morning. We'll start loading general cargo at 9 AM today. Have you prepared the loading plan and tools?
pairs.zh: 早上好。我们今天上午9点开始装载杂货。装货计划和工具准备好了吗？

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: The loading plan is ready. All cargo-handling equipment, including the cranes and slings, has been inspected and is in good condition.
pairs.zh: 装货计划已备妥。起重机、吊索等装卸设备均已检查，状态良好。

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: Great. Pay attention to the loading sequence, heavy goods at the bottom and light goods on top. Avoid overloading each hold.
pairs.zh: 很好。注意装货顺序，重货在下、轻货在上，避免货舱超载。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: Understood. We'll follow the plan strictly and check the weight of each batch of goods.
pairs.zh: 明白。我们会严格按方案执行，核对每批货物重量。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: Also, secure the goods tightly after loading to prevent shifting during navigation. Report any damaged goods in time.
pairs.zh: 另外，装货后加固货物，防止航行中移位，破损货物及时上报。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: Yes, sir. We'll use ropes and nets to fix the goods. Damaged goods will be marked and reported immediately.
pairs.zh: 收到，长官。我们会用绳索、网具固定货物，破损货物立即标记上报。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: Alright. Cooperate with the crew closely and finish the loading work efficiently.
pairs.zh: 好的。与船员密切配合，高效完成装货作业。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 货物装卸作业
pairs.en: Will do, sir. We'll ensure the safety and quality of the loading operation.
pairs.zh: 是，先生。我们会确保装货作业的安全和质量。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: What's the latest weather forecast and sea condition report for our route?
pairs.zh: 我们航线的最新天气预报和海况报告是什么？

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: Captain, the latest forecast shows that there will be moderate rain and force 5-6 winds in the afternoon, with swells of 2-3 meters.
pairs.zh: 船长，最新预报显示下午有中雨，风力5—6级，涌浪高2—3米。

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: Not good. Will the weather get worse in the evening? Any storm warnings?
pairs.zh: 情况不佳。晚间天气会恶化吗？有风暴预警吗？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: No storm warnings, but the wind will increase to force 7 at night, and visibility will decrease to 3 nautical miles.
pairs.zh: 无风暴预警，但夜间风力增至 7 级，能见度降至 3 海里。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: Understood. Adjust the ship's speed appropriately, reduce to 12 knots to avoid rough sea impact.
pairs.zh: 明白。适当调整航速，降至 12 节，规避大浪冲击。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: Yes, Captain. I'll update the weather information every hour and inform you of any changes.
pairs.zh: 收到，船长。我每小时更新天气信息，有变动及时告知您。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: Good. Remind all crew members to fasten loose items on deck and pay attention to safety during work.
pairs.zh: 好的。提醒全体船员固定甲板松散物品，作业时注意安全。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 天气与海况沟通
pairs.en: Will do. I'll post the weather notice on the bulletin board immediately.
pairs.zh: 遵命。我立刻将天气通知张贴在公告栏。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 设备故障报修
pairs.en: Bosun, the deck crane is not operating normally. It makes an unusual noise on starting and cannot develop the expected lifting power.
pairs.zh: 水手长，甲板起重机工作异常，启动时有异响，起吊能力不足。

pairs.title: 设备故障报修
pairs.en: When did the problem start? Have you checked the power supply and control switch?
pairs.zh: 什么时候出现的故障？检查过电源和控制开关吗？

pairs.title: 设备故障报修
pairs.en: The problem started 10 minutes ago. The power supply is normal and the control switch has no visible damage.
pairs.zh: 故障始于10分钟前。电源正常，控制开关没有可见损坏。

pairs.title: 设备故障报修
pairs.en: Stop using the crane. I will inform the Chief Officer and arrange for an engineer to inspect it.
pairs.zh: 停止使用起重机。我会报告大副，并安排轮机员检查。

pairs.title: 设备故障报修
pairs.en: Yes. Should I clean the surrounding area of the crane and set up warning signs?
pairs.zh: 收到。需要清理起重机周边区域、设置警示标识吗？
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 设备故障报修
pairs.en: Yes, do that right now. Don't let any crew approach the faulty equipment.
pairs.zh: 是的，立刻执行，禁止船员靠近故障设备。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 设备故障报修
pairs.en: Understood. I'll finish it at once and wait for the engineer's inspection.
pairs.zh: 明白，我马上处理，等候轮机员检修。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: We will depart from the port in one hour. Have all departure preparations been completed?
pairs.zh: 一小时后离港，所有离港准备工作完成了吗？

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: Yes, Captain. The mooring parties are ready for letting go. The anchors are ready for use, and all loose deck equipment has been secured.
pairs.zh: 是的，船长。解缆人员已经就位，锚已备妥，甲板上的活动设备已固定。

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: Good. Check the communication system with the port and confirm the departure time again.
pairs.zh: 很好。检查与港口的通讯系统，再次确认离港时间。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: Checked, the communication system is normal. The port confirms we can depart at the scheduled time.
pairs.zh: 已检查，通讯正常，港口确认可按时离港。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: Inform the engine room to stand by the main engine and adjust the power according to the departure instructions.
pairs.zh: 通知机舱主机备车，按离港指令调整动力。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: Understood. I've sent the notice to the engine room, and they are ready.
pairs.zh: 明白，已通知机舱，他们已准备就绪。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: Also, arrange crew to stand by at key positions and report the situation at any time.
pairs.zh: 另外，安排船员在关键岗位待命，随时汇报情况。
pairs.speaker: C1

pairs.title: 离港与靠泊准备
pairs.en: Will do. All crew are in place and waiting for your order.
pairs.zh: 遵命，全体船员已就位，等候您的指令。
pairs.speaker: C2

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Roger. I will rig the pilot ladder on the starboard side, with the lower end one metre above the water. Over.
pairs.zh: 收到。我会在右舷装设引航梯，下端距水面一米。完毕，请回答。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Change back to VHF channel 16.
pairs.zh: 转回VHF 16频道。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Second Officer, the pilot requests the pilot ladder on the starboard side, with the lower end one metre above the water.
pairs.zh: 二副，引航员要求在右舷装设引航梯，下端距水面一米。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Pilot ladder on the starboard side, lower end one metre above the water.
pairs.zh: 引航梯装在右舷，下端距水面一米。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Roger. I'll rig it now.
pairs.zh: 收到。我现在就放。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Second Officer, tell Mike to wear the required personal protective equipment when rigging the ladder.
pairs.zh: 二副，请提醒迈克装设引航梯时穿戴规定的个人防护用品。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: The Pilot will come aboard at around 09:20 as planned.
pairs.zh: 引航员将按计划于09:20左右登船。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Third Mate, stand by engine.
pairs.zh: 三副，备车。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Engine stand by, sir.
pairs.zh: 车备妥，长官。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Good morning, Captain.
pairs.zh: 早上好，船长。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Good morning, Pilot. The engine is at half ahead, and our course is 000 degrees.
pairs.zh: 早上好，引航员。主机半速前进，航向000度。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Increase to full ahead and alter course to 002 degrees.
pairs.zh: 主机调至全速前进，转向002度。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Captain, there's an escort boat about 500 meters ahead.
pairs.zh: 船长，前方约500米处有一艘护航艇。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Thank goodness that the visibility is good today.
pairs.zh: 谢天谢地，今天的能见度很好。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Yes. There are too many fishing boats about.
pairs.zh: 是的。附近有太多的渔船。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: I hope that they don't cross our route.
pairs.zh: 我希望他们不会穿过我们的航线。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: What is the top speed we can do?
pairs.zh: 我们能开的最高速度是多少？

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: We can do about 11.8 knots maximum, since we are half laden.
pairs.zh: 本船半载时最高航速约为11.8节。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: She can go astern quickly at this speed.
pairs.zh: 以这种速度她可以很快倒车。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: The engine crew, however, has advised us not to go to full-speed astern for more than a minute at a time, except for in an emergency.
pairs.zh: 然而，机舱人员建议我们一次全速倒车不要超过一分钟，除非有紧急情况。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: I see. I'll take account of that.
pairs.zh: 我明白了。我会考虑的。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: There are the fishing boats.
pairs.zh: 那里有渔船。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Please tell those fishing boats to keep clear of our course.
pairs.zh: 请告诉那些渔船远离我们的航线。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: We encountered a lot of fishing boats in the Malacca Straits during this voyage.
pairs.zh: 在这次航行中，我们在马六甲海峡遇到了很多渔船。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: There always seems to be many fishing boats there.
pairs.zh: 那里似乎总是有许多渔船。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Yes. They are equipped with modern engines now and are very quick.
pairs.zh: 是的。他们现在配备了现代化的发动机，速度很快。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Before we reach that buoy, hoist the signal flags specified in the agreed berthing instructions.
pairs.zh: 到达那个浮标前，按已确认的靠泊指示升挂规定的信号旗。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: I will. Have you got any berthing instructions for us?
pairs.zh: 我会的。你有给我们的靠泊指示吗？

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: We will berth starboard side alongside at the West Berth.
pairs.zh: 本船将在西泊位右舷靠泊。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: I understand. Thank you.
pairs.zh: 我明白了。谢谢你！

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Third Mate, tell the Chief Mate to bring us to berth on starboard side.
pairs.zh: 三副，告诉大副我们右舷靠。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: And prepare the flags.
pairs.zh: 准备好旗子。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: Half ahead means half speed ahead; full ahead means full manoeuvring speed ahead.
pairs.zh: 半速前进表示前进半速挡，全速前进表示前进操纵全速挡。

pairs.title: 引航梯登船
pairs.en: The engine order settings are dead slow ahead, slow ahead, half ahead and full ahead.
pairs.zh: 前进车钟挡位为微速前进、慢速前进、半速前进和全速前进。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Mike, stand by the winch.
pairs.zh: 麦克，准备缆机。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: The rest of you, man the ropes.
pairs.zh: 剩下的人，准备缆绳。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: The clutch is set, sir.
pairs.zh: 离合已合上，先生。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Stand by to pay out the line under power.
pairs.zh: 准备使用缆机动力松缆。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: OK. pay out slowly.
pairs.zh: 好的。慢慢松。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Sailors, pull the end.
pairs.zh: 水手们，拉绳尾端。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Bosun, should the end be in this position?
pairs.zh: 水手长，尾端应该在这个位置吗？

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: That's fine. Now put the eye just between the rollers.
pairs.zh: 很好。现在把缆绳眼环放在导缆滚轮之间。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: carry this the same way you carry that.
pairs.zh: 搬这个时，也用搬那个的方法。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: just a moment.
pairs.zh: 请稍等。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: I'll help you. Bosun, we're ready.
pairs.zh: 我会帮你的。水手长，准备好了。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: OK. MIKE, pay out.
pairs.zh: 好的。麦克，松。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Roger. pay out now.
pairs.zh: 收到。现在松缆。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: That's it. Take it out like you did before. Mike, stop.
pairs.zh: 就是这样。像之前一样取出来。麦克，停下来。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: The hawsers are OK.
pairs.zh: 缆绳没有问题。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Now let us handle the breast wires.
pairs.zh: 现在处理横向钢丝缆。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: We need to shift the wires from the port side using the messenger rope, because we will berth starboard side alongside.
pairs.zh: 本船要右舷靠泊，因此需要用引缆把钢丝缆从左舷移过去。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: take this messenger rope to the starboard capstan.
pairs.zh: 把这根引缆接到右舷绞盘上。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Yes, sir. Bosun, stand by heaving in, sir.
pairs.zh: 是，长官。水手长，准备绞，长官。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Just a moment.
pairs.zh: 请稍等。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Mike, be careful that the shackle won't get caught in the deck roller.
pairs.zh: 迈克，小心，不要让卸扣卡在甲板导缆滚轮处。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Bosun, stand by, sir.
pairs.zh: 水手长，准备，长官。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Peter, pay out. Mike, slowly heave in.
pairs.zh: 皮特，松。麦克，慢慢绞。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: the shackle is coming. Watch it!
pairs.zh: 卸扣就要来了。小心！

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Bosun, the shackle is coming our way.
pairs.zh: 水手长，卸扣朝我们这边来了。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Mike, heave in slowly. Hold on. Peter, stop for a moment.
pairs.zh: 迈克，慢慢绞进。停住。彼得，先停一下。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Mike, where is it?
pairs.zh: 麦克，它在哪里？

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: It's just in the roller's hook. I think it's OK.
pairs.zh: 它就在滚筒的钩上。我觉得还可以。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Roger. Peter, pay out again.
pairs.zh: 收到。皮特，继续松缆。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Mike, heave in slowly.
pairs.zh: 麦克，慢慢绞。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Bosun, the shackle is passing.
pairs.zh: 水手长，卸扣已经过去了。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: It passed clearly, sir.
pairs.zh: 卸扣已顺利通过，先生。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: OK. Stop. Remove the messenger rope.
pairs.zh: 好的。停止。拆下引缆。

pairs.title: 甲板带缆作业
pairs.en: Let's go to the next one.
pairs.zh: 让我们看下一个。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Oh, Second Mate, there you are.
pairs.zh: 哦，二副，你来了。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I would like to ask you about the passage plan you prepared.
pairs.zh: 我想问一下你编制的航次计划。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, what is it?
pairs.zh: 是的，什么事？

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Our estimated speed is 14.5 knots.
pairs.zh: 我们的估计速度是14.5节。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Is this the same speed as we made on our last voyage?
pairs.zh: 这和我们上次航行的速度一样吗？

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, it is.
pairs.zh: 是的，它是。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: We also did the same speed on the one before that.
pairs.zh: 再前一个航次也保持过同样的航速。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I know. But, on our next voyage. We might be going against the current.
pairs.zh: 我知道。但是，在下次航行中。我们可能是逆流而行。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: That could slow us down by one or two knots.
pairs.zh: 那可能使航速降低一到两节。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I think I wrote that down in the pilot chart.
pairs.zh: 我记得在航路设计图上记下了这一点。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I wondered which one I should choose. I referred to the record of our last two voyages.
pairs.zh: 我不知道该选哪一个。我查阅了我们最近两次航行的记录。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: At this time of year, there is a strong counter-current.
pairs.zh: 在每年的这个时候，有一股强烈的逆流。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: That's what happened last year.
pairs.zh: 这就是去年发生的事情。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Up until now, the ship's hull is pretty clean.
pairs.zh: 到目前为止，这艘船的船体相当干净。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I think you should calculate our speed as 13 knots.
pairs.zh: 我认为应按13节航速进行计算。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, sir. I will.
pairs.zh: 好的，先生，我会的。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Did you calculate our ETA on your PC?
pairs.zh: 你在电脑上计算我们的预计到达时间了吗？

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, I did.
pairs.zh: 是的，已经算过了。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: We have a program in Excel.
pairs.zh: 我们有一个Excel程序。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: When you enter the waypoint, then it gives you the ETA automatically.
pairs.zh: 输入航路点后，程序就会自动算出预计到达时间。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Third Mate, this program is probably really useful, but for the time being, you should learn how to do the calculations by hand.
pairs.zh: 三副，这个程序可能真的很有用，但就目前而言，你应该学会如何手工计算。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: This way, you will know how to calculate the ETA correctly.
pairs.zh: 这样，您将知道如何正确地计算ETA。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, I'll try to do it by hand and if I need help, I'll ask the Second Officer.
pairs.zh: 是的，我会试着手工做，如果我需要帮助，我去问二副。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Can I use a calculator with trigonometric functions?
pairs.zh: 我可以用三角函数计算器吗？

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Why, of course.
pairs.zh: 当然了。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: You should first learn how to calculate the distance between two points.
pairs.zh: 你应该首先学会如何计算两点之间的距离。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: It's really interesting.
pairs.zh: 这真的很有趣。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I did it at school, and I'm sure I can still remember how to do it.
pairs.zh: 我在学校做过，我肯定我还记得怎么做。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Good evening, sir.
pairs.zh: 晚上好，先生。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: May I take over the watch?
pairs.zh: 我可以接班了吗？

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Present course and speed are 218 degrees, at 15.5 knots.
pairs.zh: 当前航向和速度是218度，15.5节。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: We have maintained the same speed for the last four hours.
pairs.zh: 在过去的四个小时里，我们一直保持着同样的速度。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: The distance to the next waypoint is about seven miles, and we'll reach it sometime after 20:30.
pairs.zh: 到下一个航路点的距离大约是7海里，我们会在20:30之后到达。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: The current effect is light, and visibility is good.
pairs.zh: 海流影响较小，能见度良好。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, sir. Our course is 218.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。我们的航向是218。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: The vessel showing a green sidelight is on an approximately reciprocal course.
pairs.zh: 那艘显示绿舷灯的船正沿与本船大致相反的航向航行。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Her distance is 6 miles, and her course is about 035 degrees, which is just about our opposite.
pairs.zh: 该船距离本船6海里，航向约035度，与本船航向大致相反。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: The CPA is 2 miles.
pairs.zh: 最近会遇距离为2海里。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: There's another ship, far away off our port side, at a distance of 15 miles.
pairs.zh: 还有一艘船，离我们的左舷很远，距离15海里。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I've observed it on radar, and its course is also opposite of ours.
pairs.zh: 我在雷达上观察到了，它的航向也和我们的相反。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: We should be able to see her mast light soon.
pairs.zh: 我们应该很快就能看到它的桅灯了。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, sir. (He looks for it with the binoculars)
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。(他用望远镜找。)

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I can't see it yet.
pairs.zh: 我还看不见。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: There's one more ship, this one following about 2 miles behind us; it's the small one that we overtook awhile back.
pairs.zh: 还有一艘船，这个在我们后面2海里，是我们刚才超过的那条小的。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I haven't seen any fishing boats, but the Second Mate saw a lot of them during his watch.
pairs.zh: 我没看到任何渔船，但是二副在值班期间看到了很多。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Keep a close watch for them.
pairs.zh: 密切注意他们。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: I haven't received any navigation warnings.
pairs.zh: 我没有收到任何航行警告。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: You've read the Captain's night orders, right?
pairs.zh: 你已经读过船长的夜航命令了，对吗？

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Yes, I have. I'll take over, sir. Thank you.
pairs.zh: 是的，我已经读过了。我现在接班，谢谢。

pairs.title: 驾驶台值班与航行规划
pairs.en: Good night.
pairs.zh: 晚安。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Engineer, we are replacing the main engine exhaust valve.
pairs.zh: 轮机员，我们正在更换主机排气阀。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Remember, whenever you work in the Engine Room, wear a safety helmet and don't pass under any heavy machinery that's suspended from hoists.
pairs.zh: 记住，无论何时你在机舱工作，戴上安全帽，不要从悬挂在起重机上的重型机械下面通过。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Please show me everything you can.
pairs.zh: 请尽你所能给我看看。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: This is my first time on a Chinese ship, and I want to learn as much as possible.
pairs.zh: 这是我第一次在中国船，我想尽可能多地学习。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: On this vessel, the assigned engineer is responsible for the provision refrigeration plant, air-conditioning plant, evaporator, their auxiliary pumps and electrical equipment.
pairs.zh: 本船指定的轮机员负责伙食冷藏装置、空调装置、蒸发式造水设备、相关辅助泵及船舶电气设备。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: The assigned engineer also manages the fuel oil system, maintains the purifiers, keeps the logbook and submits the noon report.
pairs.zh: 指定的轮机员还负责燃油系统管理、分油机维护、填写日志和提交午报。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Read the engineer handover notes for the details.
pairs.zh: 详细情况请查看轮机员交接记录。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: I am familiar with electrical and refrigeration equipment, but I am less familiar with fuel oil system management.
pairs.zh: 我熟悉电气和制冷设备，但对燃油系统管理还不太熟悉。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Please teach me as much as you can.
pairs.zh: 请尽可能多地教我。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: This is my third vessel in this engineering role.
pairs.zh: 这是我担任这一轮机岗位的第三艘船。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Practical training is as important as theoretical study.
pairs.zh: 实际操作训练与理论学习同样重要。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Thanks. By the way, I'm surprised at how clean it is in the Engine Room.
pairs.zh: 谢谢。顺便说一下，我很惊讶机舱这么干净。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Thank you. To work efficiently, it's really important to keep things clean and tidy.
pairs.zh: 谢谢你！要有效率地工作，保持东西干净整洁真的很重要。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: It also helps you quickly spot any trouble.
pairs.zh: 它还可以帮助您快速发现任何问题。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: I'd like to know what you think of the schedule for the safety and sanitation meeting.
pairs.zh: 我想知道你对安全卫生会议的日程安排有什么看法。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: The engine crew is scheduled to chip the pipeline on the Upper Deck during the next voyage, so we should demonstrate how to use and care for chipping goggles.
pairs.zh: 下航次轮机部计划对上甲板管路敲锈，因此应示范除锈护目镜的使用和保养。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: And we should explain what to do if you get rust in your eyes.
pairs.zh: 我们应该解释一下如果你眼睛里进锈片了该怎么办。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: OK. So the theme for the next voyage has been decided.
pairs.zh: 好的。所以，下一次航行的主题已经确定了。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: But we have to get the crew to practice what they learn.
pairs.zh: 但我们必须让船员们实践他们学到的东西。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: We should check up on them before they start work.
pairs.zh: 我们应该在他们开始工作之前对他们进行检查。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: It is good to know that we are all ready to do our jobs.
pairs.zh: 很高兴知道我们都准备好了做好我们的工作。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Arrange a pre-work briefing so everyone understands the safety measures for the task.
pairs.zh: 安排工前会，让大家了解本次作业的安全措施。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Is there anything else?
pairs.zh: 还有别的吗？

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: Last time, for recreation day, the Third Mate had planned a game of golf on the deck, but it rained that day.
pairs.zh: 上次，在休闲日，三副打算在甲板上打高尔夫球，但是那天下雨了。

pairs.title: 机舱作业
pairs.en: So this time he's planning to organize a table tennis tournament for next week.
pairs.zh: 所以这次他计划在下周组织一场乒乓球锦标赛。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Good morning, Chief Mate.
pairs.zh: 早上好，大副。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: How're you doing?
pairs.zh: 你好吗？

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Good morning, I'm fine, thanks.
pairs.zh: 早上好，我很好，谢谢。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: How about you?
pairs.zh: 你呢？

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: I'm doing pretty well, I guess.
pairs.zh: 我感觉还不错。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Did you have a good voyage?
pairs.zh: 旅途愉快吗？

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: We ran into two big storms on the way here, but we managed to survive.
pairs.zh: 我们在来的路上遇到了两次大风暴，但我们还是活了下来。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Please have a seat.
pairs.zh: 请坐。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: I'll get you some coffee.
pairs.zh: 我给你倒杯咖啡。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: How would you like your coffee?
pairs.zh: 您的咖啡要加些什么？

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: With milk only, please.
pairs.zh: 请只加牛奶。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: I'm on a diet.
pairs.zh: 我正在节食。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: So you are the new Third Mate.
pairs.zh: 所以你是新的三副了。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Nice to meet you.
pairs.zh: 见到你很高兴。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Nice to meet you, too.
pairs.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: We are carrying a lot of reefer containers on this voyage, aren't we?
pairs.zh: 这次航行我们装载了很多冷藏集装箱，是吗？

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Yes, we are.
pairs.zh: 是的，本航次装了很多冷藏集装箱。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: There aren't so many oranges, but there sure are a lot of melons.
pairs.zh: 没有那么多橙子了，但瓜确实有很多。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: There are about one and a half times as many as on the last voyage.
pairs.zh: 数量大约是上航次的1.5倍。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: That many!
pairs.zh: 这么多！

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: The deck is going to be loaded.
pairs.zh: 甲板上将装满货物。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: This ship has power supply problems because she's so old.
pairs.zh: 这艘船有电力供应问题，因为它太老了。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: I know.
pairs.zh: 我知道。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: I'll bring the final plan later on.
pairs.zh: 我稍后会带来最终方案。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: The power supply should be sufficient, but the initial metacentric height, GM, may be low.
pairs.zh: 供电应当足够，但初稳性高度GM可能偏小。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: I'll let the engine crew know about this.
pairs.zh: 我会通知机舱人员的。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: An auxiliary generator may be needed.
pairs.zh: 可能需要一台辅助发电机。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: What is the initial metacentric height, GM?
pairs.zh: 初稳性高度GM是多少？

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: About 50 cm.
pairs.zh: 大约50厘米。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: We must verify this loading condition against the approved stability information.
pairs.zh: 必须根据经批准的稳性资料核查这一装载状态。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: We can sail only after the loading condition and departure requirements have been verified.
pairs.zh: 装载状态及离港要求核实合格后，我们才能开航。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: We should be able to depart on Wednesday evening if everything goes well.
pairs.zh: 如果一切顺利，我们应该能在星期三晚上出发。

pairs.title: 甲板部介绍
pairs.en: Yes, I think so.
pairs.zh: 是的，我想是的。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Chief Officer, may I ask you some questions about cargo operations?
pairs.zh: 大副，我可以问你一些关于货物操作的问题吗？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Yes, please do.
pairs.zh: 是的，请说。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: First, could you please tell me the cargo contents from your last voyage and the quantity of each item?
pairs.zh: 首先，你能告诉我你上次航次的货物内容和每件货物的数量吗？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Yes, here is the information on contents and quantities.
pairs.zh: 是的，这是货物的种类和数量。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: OK. Now I'd also like to see the oil record book and the ship's logbook.
pairs.zh: 好的。现在我还想看看油类记录簿和航海日志。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Where is the record of bilge discharges?
pairs.zh: 舱底污水排放记录在哪里？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Here it is.
pairs.zh: 在这里。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: How about for garbage disposal?
pairs.zh: 垃圾处理呢？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: The garbage disposal entries are in the Garbage Record Book.
pairs.zh: 垃圾处理记录在《垃圾记录簿》中。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Chief Engineer, can you explain to me the bilge discharge method?
pairs.zh: 轮机长，你能给我解释一下污水排放的方式吗？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Sure. Look at this drawing.
pairs.zh: 可以。请看这个图纸。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: We collect oily bilge water in a holding tank and process it using the approved oily water separator in accordance with the applicable discharge requirements.
pairs.zh: 我们将含油舱底水收集到储存舱，并按适用排放要求使用经认可的油水分离设备处理。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: I'll show you where it's done.
pairs.zh: 我带你去看看哪里做的。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: OK. You can show me later when we are in the Engine Room.
pairs.zh: 等我们到了机舱，你可以指给我看。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Chief Officer, show me the garbage segregation and disposal arrangements.
pairs.zh: 大副，请介绍垃圾分类和处置安排。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Yes. We keep the garbage on the Poop Deck, protected from the rain and seawater.
pairs.zh: 是的。垃圾分类存放在艉楼甲板指定位置，并有防雨、防海水措施。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Where's your designated smoking area when loading at port.
pairs.zh: 在港口装船时，你们指定的吸烟区在哪里？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: We have one here and here.
pairs.zh: 这里和这里各有一个。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Let's see.
pairs.zh: 让我们来看看。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: This is the officers' smoking room, and this is the crew's smoking room, right? Thank you.
pairs.zh: 这是高级船员吸烟室，这是普通船员的吸烟室，对吧？谢谢你！

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: A few days ago I was dressed down by the Chief Officer because I was only wearing an undershirt because it was so hot.
pairs.zh: 前几天因为天气很热，我只穿了一件汗衫，被大副批评了。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: He said I should always dress well, even during meals.
pairs.zh: 他说即使用餐时也应衣着得体。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: The Second Engineer told me the same thing.
pairs.zh: 大管轮也跟我说过同样的话。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: He told me it looked bad if I went around in my underwear.
pairs.zh: 他告诉我，只穿内衣在船上走动不合适。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: He said we must always wash our work clothes and keep them clean.
pairs.zh: 他说我们必须经常洗工作服并保持干净。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Hi. What are you two talking about?
pairs.zh: 嗨。你们两个在说什么？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: You look so serious.
pairs.zh: 你看起来很严肃。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: About the dress code.
pairs.zh: 关于着装要求。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: You said we should always look neat.
pairs.zh: 你说过我们要保持整洁。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: That's right.
pairs.zh: 这是正确的。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: We might have different opinions on style, but we all agree that dirty, torn clothes look bad.
pairs.zh: 我们对风格有不同的看法，但我们都同意，脏的、撕裂的衣服看起来很糟糕。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Many people come on board when we are at port and they will leave with a bad impression of both our ship and of our seamen's discipline if we dress sloppily.
pairs.zh: 当我们在港口时，许多人上船，如果我们穿着邋遢，他们离开时就会对我们的船和船员的纪律留下不好的印象。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: What else should we be careful of?
pairs.zh: 我们还应该注意什么？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: The most important thing is to always be on time.
pairs.zh: 最重要的是要准时。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Real seamen follow the 'five minutes ahead' rule.
pairs.zh: 真正的海员遵循"提前五分钟"的规则。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: You should never be late.
pairs.zh: 你不应该迟到。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: I see, if we don't return to the ship in time for our departure, then the whole crew suffers.
pairs.zh: 我明白了，如果我们不能在出发前及时回到船上，然后整个船员都会遭殃。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Besides, a person who is late won't even be able to get on board?
pairs.zh: 此外，一个迟到的人甚至不能赶上船？

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Yes, that's right. If you're not punctual, you're not a seaman.
pairs.zh: 是的，没错。如果你不守时，你不是海员。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: On board we live in a limited space, so we must respect each other and try not to cause trouble.
pairs.zh: 船上生活空间有限，我们必须互相尊重，尽量不给他人添麻烦。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: For example, we shouldn't listen to loud music, bang doors, or leave our clothing unattended in the washing machine.
pairs.zh: 例如，不应把音乐开得太响、用力摔门，或洗好衣服后一直不从洗衣机取走。

pairs.title: 大副交接班与船上纪律
pairs.en: Oh, no! My clothes in the washing machine must be finished by now.
pairs.zh: 哦，糟了！洗衣机里的衣服这会儿想必已经洗好了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Good morning. I'm the supplier.
pairs.zh: 早上好。我是供应商。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: The supply boat is waiting behind the Poop Deck.
pairs.zh: 补给艇在船尾甲板后面等着。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Do you want me to bring the supplies up by crane?
pairs.zh: 你要我用起重机把物资运上来吗？

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Certainly. Bosun, prepare the crane.
pairs.zh: 好的。水手长，准备起重机。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Hey, I'll send you a messenger rope.
pairs.zh: 我给你送一根引缆。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Tie it to your rope. OK.
pairs.zh: 把它系在缆绳上。好的。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: They're connected. Mike, heave it up and make it fast to that cleat.
pairs.zh: 已连接上。迈克，把它拉上来，把它固定到那个羊角上。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: OK, it's fast.
pairs.zh: 好的，固定好了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: I'm lowering the hook.
pairs.zh: 我在放下钩子。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Watch your head!
pairs.zh: 小心你的头！

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: OK, stop.
pairs.zh: 好了，停止。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: There, it's hooked now, so lift it aboard.
pairs.zh: 好了，钩住了，把它拉上船。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Mike, heave that line in.
pairs.zh: 迈克，把绳子绞上来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: OK, hold on.
pairs.zh: 好的，不要动。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Swing the load in and lower it onto the deck.
pairs.zh: 把货摆进去，放到甲板上。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Wiper, look out!
pairs.zh: 机舱清洁员，小心！

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: It's dangerous around there.
pairs.zh: 那里很危险。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Stand clear.
pairs.zh: 退开，保持安全距离。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Lower it down.
pairs.zh: 放低点。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Now take the stores out of the sling.
pairs.zh: 现在把物料从吊具中卸下来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Later, will you check these with me?
pairs.zh: 过会儿，你能帮我检查一下吗？

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Hey, those cylinders are too heavy.
pairs.zh: 嘿，那些钢瓶太重了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: This is only a one-ton crane, and that load's near the limit.
pairs.zh: 这台起重机的额定起重量只有一吨，这一吊的重量已经接近极限了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Only put ten cylinders in the next sling.
pairs.zh: 下一吊只装十只钢瓶。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: All right.
pairs.zh: 好吧。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: The sea is getting rough. Reassess whether the operation can continue safely.
pairs.zh: 海况正在恶化，应重新评估作业是否能安全继续。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: OK. Let's load up everything from the boat.
pairs.zh: 好的。我们把船上的东西都搬上来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: The wind has increased. Review the operating limits before continuing.
pairs.zh: 风力已经增大，继续作业前应核查作业限制条件。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Captain, this is the Chief Mate.
pairs.zh: 船长，我是大副。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: The crane and accommodation ladder are ready, sir.
pairs.zh: 吊车和舷梯准备好了，长官。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Thanks. A supply boat is coming up on our starboard side.
pairs.zh: 谢谢。一艘补给船正从我们的右舷驶来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: When it gets here, pick up the supplies with the crane.
pairs.zh: 等它来了，用起重机把物资运来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Two ship chandlers have boarded and they say they have eight slings for us.
pairs.zh: 两名船舶供应商人员已登船，他们说有八吊物料要交给我们。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: We'll start bringing them aboard, sir.
pairs.zh: 我们这就开始把物料吊上船。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Roger. I'll hold this course and speed for a while.
pairs.zh: 收到。我要保持这个航向和速度一段时间。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Start loading.
pairs.zh: 开始装运物料。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Slack down.
pairs.zh: 松下来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Hold on.
pairs.zh: 停住。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Heave in.
pairs.zh: 收。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: OK, swing it on deck.
pairs.zh: 好，把它放到甲板上。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Slack down.
pairs.zh: 松下来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: OK, men, take the stuff out of the sling.
pairs.zh: 好了，大家把这一吊的物料卸下来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Only take the frozen food to the Chamber.
pairs.zh: 只把冷冻的食物送到冷藏室。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Leave the rest until after we finish.
pairs.zh: 剩下的留到我们完成后。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Chief Officer, I want to get the frozen stuff stowed right away.
pairs.zh: 大副，我想马上把冷冻的东西收起来。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Can you give me some people to help?
pairs.zh: 你能派人来帮我吗？

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: The deck crews are all busy unloading right now.
pairs.zh: 甲板上的人都在忙着卸货。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: take some engine crewmembers to help you.
pairs.zh: 带一些轮机部人员来帮你。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: And move those bottles more out of the way.
pairs.zh: 把那些瓶子挪远一点。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Someone might hit them.
pairs.zh: 有人可能会打到它们。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Thanks. Mess Man, move those bottles out of the way, will you?
pairs.zh: 谢谢。服务员，把那些瓶子挪开，好吗？

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: We'll take this cart right to the chamber.
pairs.zh: 我们把这车直接推到冷藏室。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Mike, they're watermelons, so be careful with them.
pairs.zh: 迈克，这是西瓜，小心点。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: OK, men, the next sling is coming.
pairs.zh: 好了，下一吊物料来了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Pump man, swing it to this side and put it down here.
pairs.zh: 泵匠，把这一吊回转到这边，在这里放下。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Captain, we have one more sling to pick up, and we've just started to lift it now.
pairs.zh: 船长，还剩一吊物料要吊上船，我们现在刚开始起吊。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Roger. Let me know when you're done, so I can increase our speed.
pairs.zh: 收到。你做完了告诉我，这样我就能加快速度了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: We're too slow against this current.
pairs.zh: 逆流而上，我们太慢了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Captain, we're finished, and the ship chandlers have left.
pairs.zh: 船长，我们结束了，供应商已经走了。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: The accommodation ladder is clear.
pairs.zh: 舷梯已清爽。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: Good work. Thanks for your help.
pairs.zh: 干得好。谢谢你的帮助。

pairs.title: 供应商与物料运送
pairs.en: You managed to do it quickly, and everyone did a good job.
pairs.zh: 你做得很快，每个人都做得很好。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Third Mate, I want to change the loading sequence a little.
pairs.zh: 三副，我想稍微改变一下装货顺序。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Is the Chief Mate there?
pairs.zh: 大副在吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: No, he's on shore getting a yellow fever vaccination.
pairs.zh: 不，他在岸上打黄热病疫苗。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: He said he'd return by 16:00.
pairs.zh: 他说他会在16点前回来。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: How do you want to change it?
pairs.zh: 你想怎么改？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: According to the Chief Mate's plan, we are supposed to load 2,000 tons at Hatch No. 2 and then 2,000 tons at Hatch No. 6 and then 1,000 tons at Hatch No.2 again.
pairs.zh: 按照大副的计划，我们应该在2号舱装2000吨，然后在6号舱装2000吨，然后再在2号舱装1000吨。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I would prefer to load the 3,000 tons at Hatch No.2 all at the same time.
pairs.zh: 我希望把2号舱的这3000吨货一次连续装完。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: It would help us finish earlier.
pairs.zh: 这样我们就能早点结束了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Well, it won't affect the trim of the ship, but I still don't think we can load that much at once.
pairs.zh: 它不会影响船的吃水差，但我还是觉得我们一次装不了那么多。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Wait a minute; I'll do some calculations.
pairs.zh: 等一下；我来计算一下。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Let us verify the proposed sequence for this vessel before deciding.
pairs.zh: 决定前先核查本船是否适合这个装货顺序。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: What do your calculations say?
pairs.zh: 你的计算结果如何？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Well, it seems to be a problem for our ship.
pairs.zh: 计算结果表明，这个方案对本船可能有问题。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: If we discharge the whole ballast of the forepeak tank we could do it, but then the trim would be too large, and the aft draft might be a problem.
pairs.zh: 如果我们把前尖舱的压载水全部排掉就可以做到，但这样吃水差就太大了，船尾吃水可能会有问题。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Well, it doesn't seem possible then.
pairs.zh: 嗯，那看起来不太可能。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I must follow your plan.
pairs.zh: 我必须按照你的计划去做。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Yes, please do.
pairs.zh: 是的，请按这个方案执行。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: By the way, is the draft checked using this schedule?
pairs.zh: 顺便问一下，吃水是用这张表核对吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: OK. Let's stick with this plan.
pairs.zh: 好的。让我们坚持这个计划。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: When can we have the exact reading?
pairs.zh: 我们什么时候能得到准确的读数？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I think I'll have a figure for you when you finish the draft check calculations.
pairs.zh: 我想等你们计算完吃水后，我会给你一个数字。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Third Mate, seawater is leaking from the topside tank in Hold No. 2.
pairs.zh: 三副，海水从二号货舱的上边舱漏出来了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Will you come and take a look?
pairs.zh: 你来看看好吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Again? This always happens.
pairs.zh: 又来？这种情况经常发生。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: OK, I'm coming.
pairs.zh: 好的，我来了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: It doesn't seem to be leaking very much.
pairs.zh: 似乎没有漏太多。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I will report the leak and follow the approved ballast and repair procedures.
pairs.zh: 我会报告泄漏情况，并按经批准的压载和修理程序处理。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I'll tell the Chief Officer about this.
pairs.zh: 我会把这件事告诉大副的。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: We are going to pick up a bulldozer from Hatch No. 6.
pairs.zh: 我们要去6号舱取一台推土机。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Please check the hold.
pairs.zh: 请检查货舱。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: OK. I'll check it after I speak to the Chief Officer.
pairs.zh: 好的。我和大副谈过之后再检查一下。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: (Third Officer goes to Hold No. 6)
pairs.zh: (三副前往6号货舱)

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Officer, I am going to check Hold No. 6.
pairs.zh: 驾驶员，我要检查6号货舱。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Be careful, Third Mate.
pairs.zh: 小心点，三副。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Take your time and be careful not to slip and fall from the ladder.
pairs.zh: 慢慢来，小心不要从梯子上滑下来。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Some seafarers try to use the vertical ladder to save time.
pairs.zh: 有些海员为了节省时间想走直梯。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Use the access route designated for this operation.
pairs.zh: 使用本次作业指定的出入通道。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Don't worry.
pairs.zh: 别担心。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I'll use the aft spiral ladder to go down inside.
pairs.zh: 我要用船尾的螺旋梯下去。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: (Third Officer comes back from the Hold)
pairs.zh: (三副从货舱回来)

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Is anything wrong?
pairs.zh: 有什么问题吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Yes. The bottom part of the spiral ladder is broken.
pairs.zh: 是的。螺旋梯的底部坏了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: It must have happened at another port.
pairs.zh: 肯定是在别的港口发生的。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I don't think it happened here.
pairs.zh: 我不认为这发生在这里。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I think that it happened here and not too long ago because the scratches look new.
pairs.zh: 我认为是在这里发生的，而且是不久以前的事，因为这些划痕看起来是新的。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Will you come down and see?
pairs.zh: 你下来看看好吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Damn! I told everyone to be careful. OK, let's go and take a look at the damage.
pairs.zh: 该死的！我告诉过大家要小心。好吧，我们去看看损坏情况吧。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Foreman, please come and inspect Hold No. 2.
pairs.zh: 工头，请过来检查2号货舱。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Of course. What's the matter?
pairs.zh: 当然可以。怎么了？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: The man who is loading the cargo has been loading the starboard side too much.
pairs.zh: 正在装货的那个人右舷装得太多了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: The other holds are evenly loaded, but too much cargo is being loaded on the starboard side of Hold No. 2.
pairs.zh: 其他货舱装载均匀，但2号舱右舷侧装得过多。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Could you please tell the cargo-loader operator to be careful?
pairs.zh: 你能告诉装货操作员小心点吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: The Chief Mate instructed us to make sure that the ship doesn't list.
pairs.zh: 大副指示我们确保船不会倾斜。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I wonder what happened.
pairs.zh: 我想知道发生了什么事。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: He was doing fine until now.
pairs.zh: 直到现在他都做得很好。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: whenever I take my eyes off things, something always goes wrong.
pairs.zh: 每当我把注意力从事情上移开，就会出问题。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I'll go and talk to him now.
pairs.zh: 我现在就去和他谈谈。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Thank you. (Through the transceiver)
pairs.zh: 谢谢你！(通过收发器)

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Hey, Jim! What are you doing?
pairs.zh: 嘿，吉姆！你在干什么？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: You're loading the starboard side too much!
pairs.zh: 你右舷装得太多了！

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: What? I'm loading the starboard side too much?
pairs.zh: 什么？我右舷装得太多了？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I don't think so.
pairs.zh: 我不这么想。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: What's wrong with you?
pairs.zh: 你怎么了？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Did you forget to wake up this morning?
pairs.zh: 你今天早上忘记起床了吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Pay attention to the loading and distribute the cargo evenly. The operator will now load the port side.
pairs.zh: 注意装货情况，保持货物分布均匀。操作员现在将向左舷侧装货。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: By the way, I'm thirsty.
pairs.zh: 顺便说一下，我渴了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Can you tell the Third Mate to bring me a can of coke. Please?
pairs.zh: 你能叫三副给我拿一罐可乐来吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: OK. But pay attention to what you're doing.
pairs.zh: 好的。但是要注意你在做什么。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Third Mate, could you please get the loader a can of coke?
pairs.zh: 三副，请给装船机操作员拿一罐可乐，好吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Again? I just gave him one a little while ago.
pairs.zh: 又拿？我刚刚才给过他一个。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: All right, I'll get him one.
pairs.zh: 好吧，我给他拿一个。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Just make sure that he does a good job.
pairs.zh: 只要确保他干得好就行。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Otherwise, I'll have the Chief Officer file a complaint.
pairs.zh: 否则，我会让大副投诉。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Hey, Third Mate, how's it going?
pairs.zh: 嘿，三副，怎么样？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Did you go ashore last night and have some fun?
pairs.zh: 你昨晚上岸玩了吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: No, I was so busy last night that I didn't have time to go ashore.
pairs.zh: 不，我昨晚太忙了，没有时间上岸。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: That's too bad.
pairs.zh: 那太糟糕了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: There are a lot of good places to go around here.
pairs.zh: 这里有很多好地方可以去。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Don't you know that it's bad for your health to work too much?
pairs.zh: 难道你不知道工作过度对你的健康有害吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Ha, ha, ha! Yeah, right.
pairs.zh: 哈，哈，哈！是的，对的。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Can you tighten the lashing bars in Bay No. 3?
pairs.zh: 请把3号贝位的绑扎杆紧固一下，好吗？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: They're loose.
pairs.zh: 它们是松的。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Those containers aren't ours.
pairs.zh: 那些集装箱不是我们的。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Their destination is Los Angeles, so it's not my job.
pairs.zh: 他们的目的地是洛杉矶，所以这不是我的工作。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I know that they're bound for Los Angeles, but they were loosened by mistake yesterday.
pairs.zh: 我知道他们要去洛杉矶，但昨天它们被错误地松开了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: So they have to be tightened again.
pairs.zh: 所以它们必须再次收紧。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: That's not my problem.
pairs.zh: 那不是我的问题。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I've been working all night in the rain and I'm tired.
pairs.zh: 我在雨中工作了一整夜，累了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Ask the foreman to do it.
pairs.zh: 让工头做。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I asked him, and he told me to have one of you workers do it.
pairs.zh: 我问他，他让我找你们中的一个人来做。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Then ask my fellow worker over there.
pairs.zh: 那就问问我那边的同事。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I asked him and he told me to ask you.
pairs.zh: 我问了他，他让我问你。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: So when you finish this one, follow me.
pairs.zh: 做完手头这项活后，跟我来。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: All right, all right.
pairs.zh: 好吧，好吧。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: I'm coming.
pairs.zh: 我来了。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Here is the lashing. Please check how tight it is.
pairs.zh: 这是那根绑扎杆，请检查它有多紧。

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: Damn! Who did this?
pairs.zh: 该死的！这是谁干的？

pairs.title: 货物操作
pairs.en: (Mumbling) I don't know, but they always come loose, so they have to be tightened anyway.
pairs.zh: (喃喃自语)我不知道，但它们总是松的，所以无论如何都要收紧。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Quartermaster, lower the gangway, please.
pairs.zh: 舵工，请放下舷梯。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Just a moment, please.
pairs.zh: 请稍等。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: We haven't finished making fast.
pairs.zh: 我们还没有完成系泊。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: I'm just waiting for the Captain's permission.
pairs.zh: 我正在等候船长许可。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: I see. Then please lower it when you're ready.
pairs.zh: 明白。准备好后请放下舷梯。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: The Captain has given permission.
pairs.zh: 船长已经许可。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: I'm lowering it now.
pairs.zh: 我现在放下舷梯。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Quartermaster, watch out for the bitt down here.
pairs.zh: 舵工，小心下面的系缆桩。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Lower it slowly, so it doesn't hit the bitt.
pairs.zh: 慢慢放，不要碰到系缆桩。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: OK. Tell me when to stop.
pairs.zh: 好的，请告诉我何时停止。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Stop.
pairs.zh: 停止。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Actually, now it's just a little too low.
pairs.zh: 现在稍微低了一点。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Can you pull it up a little?
pairs.zh: 能再升高一点吗？

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: OK. I'll raise it.
pairs.zh: 好的，我把它升高。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: How's that?
pairs.zh: 这样可以吗？

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: That's perfect.
pairs.zh: 这样正好。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: The agent comes on board.
pairs.zh: 代理登船。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: How is everything going?
pairs.zh: 一切进展如何？

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Pretty good.
pairs.zh: 一切顺利。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: We're going to lower the gangway onto the wharf after we've berthed.
pairs.zh: 靠妥后，我们会把舷梯放到码头上。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Mike, we are all fast now.
pairs.zh: 迈克，我们已经系泊完毕。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: everyone's coming, so lower the gangway onto the pier.
pairs.zh: 大家正要登船，请把舷梯放到码头上。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是，先生。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: We'll have to watch the tide.
pairs.zh: 我们得留意潮汐变化。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: It's high tide now, but tomorrow morning, when it is low tide, we'll be a lot lower.
pairs.zh: 现在是高潮，明早低潮时本船会低很多。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Monitor the gangway and adjust it as necessary as the tide falls.
pairs.zh: 退潮时持续监控舷梯，并根据需要及时调整。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: I know. I read the tide information that the Third Mate prepared for us.
pairs.zh: 我知道。我已经看过三副准备的潮汐资料。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Bosun is operating the crane.
pairs.zh: 水手长正在操作起重机。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Bosun, give it some slack!
pairs.zh: 水手长，再松一点。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: OK. Stop!
pairs.zh: 好的，停止。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Hold on. Mike, grab the hose with the rope!
pairs.zh: 停住。迈克，用绳子牵住软管。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Be careful.
pairs.zh: 小心。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Mike, I'll pass it to you on this side.
pairs.zh: 迈克，我从这边把它递给你。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Try to catch the end!
pairs.zh: 接住绳端。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: OK. I've got it.
pairs.zh: 好的，我接住了。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: I'll send it around again.
pairs.zh: 我再把它绕过去。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: That's enough.
pairs.zh: 够了。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Let's tie it to the bitt. Bosun, hold on, sir.
pairs.zh: 把它系到系缆桩上。水手长，请停住。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Give it some more slack,
pairs.zh: 再松一点，

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Be careful!
pairs.zh: 小心！

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Stay away from the hose!
pairs.zh: 离软管远一点。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: OK. Hold on.
pairs.zh: 好的，停住。

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Mike, how is it?
pairs.zh: 迈克，情况怎么样？

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Is it positioned properly?
pairs.zh: 位置放好了吗？

pairs.title: 舷梯与代理上船
pairs.en: Bosun, we need some more slack.
pairs.zh: 水手长，还需要再松一点。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: The loading port for this voyage is Port de Boke, Guinea.
pairs.zh: 本航次的装货港是几内亚的Port de Boke。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Our ETA is May 30th.
pairs.zh: 我们的预计到达时间是五月三十号。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Loading in West Africa is expected to take six days in total.
pairs.zh: 预计在西非装货总共需要六天。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: The arrival date at Yantai, the discharging port, will be around June 23rd.
pairs.zh: 到达烟台卸货港的时间会在六月二十三号左右。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: We can expect moderate weather throughout the voyage.
pairs.zh: 预计整个航次天气较为温和。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: However, visibility may be poor in the East China Sea because of rain or monsoon weather.
pairs.zh: 不过，东海海域可能受降雨或季风天气影响而出现能见度不良。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Safe navigation is most important.
pairs.zh: 航行安全是最重要的。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Also keep yourselves in good health.
pairs.zh: 保证你自己身体健康也同样重要。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: The Chief Cook and Steward crew have prepared a wonderful dinner.
pairs.zh: 厨师长和服务人员已经准备了丰盛的晚餐。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Have fun and enjoy the party.
pairs.zh: 玩得开心享受聚会。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Thank you very much, Captain.
pairs.zh: 非常感谢你，船长。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Now, we will ask our Chief Engineer to make a toast.
pairs.zh: 现在，我们邀请我们的轮机长致祝酒辞。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Does everyone have a glass?
pairs.zh: 都有杯子吗？

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Gentlemen, welcome to the great and beautiful bulk carrier, WINNING KINDNESS!
pairs.zh: 各位，欢迎登上WINNING KINDNESS散货船！

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: I'm Chief Engineer Li Qiang.
pairs.zh: 我是轮机长李强。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: First, I'd like to turn your attention to the gorgeous sunset outside.
pairs.zh: 首先，我希望你们把注意力投向外面壮美的日落。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: How lucky we are!
pairs.zh: 我们多么幸运啊！

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: I would like to make a toast to our health, our families, and to the safe navigation of this ship. Cheers!
pairs.zh: 让我们为身体健康、家人平安和本船航行安全举杯。干杯！

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Cheers! (Applause)
pairs.zh: 干杯！(掌声)

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Thank you very much.
pairs.zh: 非常感谢你。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Enjoy the feast before you: Barbecue and much more.
pairs.zh: 请享用烧烤和其他丰盛菜肴。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Later on, we will have karaoke.
pairs.zh: 稍后，我们会有卡拉OK。

pairs.title: 欢迎会与船长致辞
pairs.en: Everyone is welcome, even those who cannot carry a tune.
pairs.zh: 欢迎所有人参加，即使唱歌跑调也欢迎。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: It's a nice day at sea.
pairs.zh: 今天海上天气不错。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: It's too hot to sail at the equator.
pairs.zh: 在赤道航行真的太热了。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: It's too cold in Yantai in winter.
pairs.zh: 冬天的烟台真的太冷了。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: The party last night was great fun.
pairs.zh: 昨晚的聚会很有趣。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: The Bosun really poured his heart out when he sang Shuishou.
pairs.zh: 水手长唱《水手》时非常投入。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: Yeah, but it's bad for our health to eat so much.
pairs.zh: 吃这么多对我们的健康不好。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: We have to stay in shape and exercise regularly.
pairs.zh: 我们应该要保持身材多运动。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: Hey, did you say you would be exercising?
pairs.zh: 嘿，你是说你们会保持运动？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: I sure did. We want to sweat it out a bit.
pairs.zh: 我们确实会，我们想出点汗。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: What kind of exercise do you do, Second Officer?
pairs.zh: 二副，你会做什么运动？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: I lift weights and do push-ups, and then I run around the deck three times.
pairs.zh: 我平时举重、做俯卧撑，然后我会绕着甲板跑三圈。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: Which sports are popular in your country?
pairs.zh: 你们国家流行哪些运动？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: We used to swim and play football at school.
pairs.zh: 我们以前在学校常游泳、踢足球。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: But there are few facilities, so we can't always enjoy sports.
pairs.zh: 但那设施很少，所以我们并不总能参加体育活动。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: How about in China?
pairs.zh: 中国怎么样？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: I know that many sports are very popular there.
pairs.zh: 我知道那有很多很受欢迎的运动。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: As far as children are concerned, basketball is the most popular sport.
pairs.zh: 就孩子们而言，篮球最受欢迎。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: We enjoy football.
pairs.zh: 我们喜欢足球。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: Let's go watch a video.
pairs.zh: 让我们一起看个视频。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: That's a good idea since we can't watch TV in here.
pairs.zh: 这里看不了电视，所以看录像是个好主意。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: What kind of videos do they have?
pairs.zh: 他们有什么种类的电影？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: There are quite a few American movies and many Chinese movies.
pairs.zh: 有一些美国电影和很多中国电影。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: But we don't understand Chinese.
pairs.zh: 不过，我们不懂中文。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: American movies are not bad.
pairs.zh: 美国电影还不错。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: How about "Back to the Future"?
pairs.zh: 《回到未来》怎么样？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: It's about a young boy's adventure.
pairs.zh: 它讲的是一个年轻男孩的奇遇。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: He travels in time into the past and the future.
pairs.zh: 他穿梭在过去和未来。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: This one here is pretty good.
pairs.zh: 这个很好。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: Are you going to watch a movie?
pairs.zh: 你们打算看电影吗？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: May I join you?
pairs.zh: 我可以加入吗？

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: Sure. Come right in.
pairs.zh: 当然可以，请进。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: We were trying to decide what to watch.
pairs.zh: 我们刚才正在商量看什么。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: There are many good Chinese videos.
pairs.zh: 有很多中国电影。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: One good choice is Goodbye Mr. Loser.
pairs.zh: 《夏洛特烦恼》是个不错的选择。

pairs.title: 日常聊天与船上娱乐
pairs.en: That is a good choice.
pairs.zh: 那是一个好的选择。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Now you must wear a safety helmet and safety shoes.
pairs.zh: 现在必须戴好安全帽，穿好安全鞋。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: But the safety helmet makes me hot, and the safety shoes are too heavy.
pairs.zh: 但是戴安全帽很热，工作鞋太沉。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Would lighter equipment still provide adequate protection?
pairs.zh: 较轻便的装备也能提供足够防护吗？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Comfort matters, but the personal protective equipment must be appropriate for the task and risks.
pairs.zh: 舒适很重要，但个人防护用品必须适合具体作业及风险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: For example, you might slip while painting and hit your head on the pipeline.
pairs.zh: 例如，刷漆时可能滑倒，头部撞上管路。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Or the radio antenna may break and fall on the deck.
pairs.zh: 或者无线电天线坏了跌落到甲板。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: These accidents have happened before.
pairs.zh: 这些事故以前发生过。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: We never know what may happen.
pairs.zh: 我们永远不会知道什么会发生。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I think we should always wear protective gear.
pairs.zh: 我想我们应该总是穿戴防护用具。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: When responding to an emergency, we won't have time to get our safety helmets or shoes in an emergency.
pairs.zh: 应对紧急情况时，在紧急情况下，我们没有时间去穿戴安全帽和工作鞋。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I'd rather be always ready for an emergency.
pairs.zh: 我宁愿总是为紧急情况做好准备。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: That's good thinking.
pairs.zh: 这是个好想法。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: We don't have to worry about accidents all of the time, but if you wear safety gear, you will be more prepared if an accident happens.
pairs.zh: 我们不必总是担心事故会发生，但是，如果你穿戴安全护具，当事故发生时，你会更有准备。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: If you aren't dressed properly, It might slow down your work.
pairs.zh: 如果防护用品穿戴不当，那会减慢你的工作速度。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I understand. Somebody told me that we should never run on deck.
pairs.zh: 我理解，有人告诉我，在甲板上不要跑。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Yes. You see, You could slip and fall or you could trip on a rope, resulting in serious injuries.
pairs.zh: 是的，你明白，你可能会滑倒、跌倒或者被绳子绊倒，而导致严重的受伤。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Take particular care on deck, especially on epoxy-painted surfaces.
pairs.zh: 在甲板上要特别小心，尤其是涂有环氧漆的部位。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: That paint becomes wet and slippery when it is humid.
pairs.zh: 当天气潮湿时，环氧漆会变得湿滑。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: A hawser can also part, and that could be dangerous for the crew.
pairs.zh: 缆绳也可能断裂，那会给船员带来危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: So be careful when you are on stand-by.
pairs.zh: 因此，在系泊作业待命时也要格外小心。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Also, be careful when you see a running rope.
pairs.zh: 当你看到移动的绳子，也要当心。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: It could snap and whip you.
pairs.zh: 缆绳可能突然断裂、回弹并击中人员。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Wait! Don't pass by there!
pairs.zh: 等等！不要从那里走！

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: There's a safety rope there, and you might stumble there.
pairs.zh: 那里有一根安全绳，你可能会绊倒。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Walk on the other side, on the port side.
pairs.zh: 从另一侧走，从左舷走。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: But going by the starboard side is faster.
pairs.zh: 但是从右舷走更快。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: You're right, but it's more dangerous walking on the starboard side.
pairs.zh: 是的，但是从右舷走更危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Lumps of ore could fall through a gap in the grab.
pairs.zh: 矿石块可能会从抓斗的裂缝中跌落到甲板。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: You'd be seriously injured if a lump hits you.
pairs.zh: 如果矿石块砸到你的话，你会严重受伤。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: It could even kill you.
pairs.zh: 这甚至会杀了你。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Even when the grab is still on shore,
pairs.zh: 甚至即使抓斗还在岸上，

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: it's hard to walk on the deck because it gets covered with ore.
pairs.zh: 因为甲板上覆盖了一层矿砂，在甲板上行走很困难。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I see. I'll be sure to walk on the port side.
pairs.zh: 明白。我一定从左舷通行。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I have to remember that there are many dangerous things on board.
pairs.zh: 我不得不记住，在船上有很多危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: You may not believe it, but there was an accident like that on a bulk carrier just recently.
pairs.zh: 你不会相信，但是，就在近期，在一条散货船上就发生了类似的事故。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: A lashing worker from the shore fell from the top of the bulwark.
pairs.zh: 一名来自岸上的绑扎工人从舷墙跌落。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: And he was very experienced.
pairs.zh: 这个工人非常有经验。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: The wire in his hand swung him around, and he lost his balance.
pairs.zh: 他手中的钢丝绳突然甩动，把他带得转了身，导致他失去平衡。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: He was taken to the hospital by ambulance, but the accident nearly cost him his life.
pairs.zh: 他被救护车带到医院，这次事故险些使他丧命。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: He fell on the wharf right by the gangway that the crew uses to go on shore.
pairs.zh: 他摔到船员上下船所用的舷梯旁边的码头上。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Unfortunately, no one was there when he fell.
pairs.zh: 不幸的是，他跌落的时候，附近没有人在。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Follow this vessel's restrictions on carrying matches and lighters on deck.
pairs.zh: 遵守本船关于在甲板携带火柴和打火机的限制。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: The restrictions may also apply in accommodation areas.
pairs.zh: 有关限制也可能适用于生活区。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I guess that's why we should smoke only in designated areas.
pairs.zh: 我猜这是为什么要在指定地点吸烟的原因。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: There are matches there, and the ashtrays are filled with water.
pairs.zh: 那里有火柴，烟灰缸里装满了水。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I smoke now, but I've made up my mind to quit smoking.
pairs.zh: 我现在吸烟，但是我已经下定决心戒烟了。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: It will be better for my health, too.
pairs.zh: 这对我的健康也有好处。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: What are some other dangers?
pairs.zh: 还有哪些其他的危险？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: There is a shortage of oxygen.
pairs.zh: 这里缺氧。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: An enclosed tank may contain an oxygen-deficient atmosphere.
pairs.zh: 封闭液舱内可能存在缺氧气氛。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Let's talk more about fire and explosions.
pairs.zh: 我们来谈谈火灾和爆炸吧。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: For a flammable gas explosion to occur, the mixture, oxygen supply and ignition conditions must permit it.
pairs.zh: 要发生可燃气体爆炸，混合物、供氧和点火条件必须达到可发生爆炸的状态。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: You mean there must be oxygen, too?
pairs.zh: 你是说肯定也有氧气？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: An ignition source is also relevant.
pairs.zh: 点火源也是相关条件。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: You're right.
pairs.zh: 你是对的。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Another important factor is the concentration of the gas mixture.
pairs.zh: 另一个重要因素是混合气体的浓度。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: What I am about to tell you is a little advanced, but we have to discuss it so you are aware of the dangers.
pairs.zh: 我要告诉你的有点高级，但我们必须讨论一下，这样你才能意识到危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Are you talking about LEL or UEL?
pairs.zh: 你说的是LEL还是UEL？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Static electricity can also be an ignition hazard.
pairs.zh: 静电也可能构成点火危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Is it safe on deck?
pairs.zh: 甲板上安全吗？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Before chipping or welding, follow the approved risk assessment, work permit and atmosphere-testing requirements.
pairs.zh: 敲锈或焊接前，应遵守经批准的风险评估、作业许可和气体检测要求。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Identify the gases and apply the limits specified for the substance and the intended work.
pairs.zh: 应确认气体种类，并采用该物质及拟进行作业所适用的限值。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
