pairs.en: I saw breathing apparatus near the pump-room entrance.
pairs.zh: 我在泵房入口附近看到了呼吸器。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: When is that equipment used?
pairs.zh: 这种设备在什么情况下使用？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Only trained personnel may use the specified breathing apparatus under the approved procedure.
pairs.zh: 规定的呼吸器须由受过训练的人员按经批准的程序使用。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: The equipment must be suitable for the atmosphere and the task.
pairs.zh: 设备必须适合现场气氛和具体任务。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Wearing breathing apparatus alone does not make an unsafe space safe to enter.
pairs.zh: 仅仅佩戴呼吸器并不能使不安全处所变得可以安全进入。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Can oxygen deficiency occur on this vessel even though it is a coal-ore carrier without an inert gas system?
pairs.zh: 本船也可能出现缺氧吗，即使它是一艘没有惰性气体系统的煤矿石运输船？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Yes. The absence of an inert gas system does not remove the risk of oxygen deficiency.
pairs.zh: 会。没有惰性气体系统并不意味着没有缺氧危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Cargo holds and connected enclosed spaces can still have hazardous atmospheres.
pairs.zh: 货舱及与其相通的封闭处所仍可能存在危险气氛。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Why is that?
pairs.zh: 为什么呢？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Hazardous atmospheres can occur in cofferdams, double-bottom ballast tanks and lower stool spaces.
pairs.zh: 隔离空舱、双层底压载舱和下底凳内部空间都可能出现危险气氛。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: When coal is carried, there is a danger of asphyxiation.
pairs.zh: 运输煤炭时，有窒息的危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Why is that?
pairs.zh: 为什么呢？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Does entering a space regularly mean that its atmosphere is safe?
pairs.zh: 经常进入一个处所，就能说明其中的气氛安全吗？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: No. Familiarity with the space is not proof that it is safe.
pairs.zh: 不能。熟悉这个处所并不证明它是安全的。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: It's rust.
pairs.zh: 这是生锈。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Oxygen is consumed when iron rusts.
pairs.zh: 铁生锈时氧气就被消耗掉了。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: This uses up the oxygen over time.
pairs.zh: 随着时间的推移，这会耗尽氧气。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Before entering an enclosed space, follow the approved entry procedure and test the atmosphere.
pairs.zh: 进入封闭处所前，必须遵守经批准的进入程序并检测气氛。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Use suitable calibrated equipment to test for oxygen, flammable gases and relevant toxic gases, in accordance with the approved procedure.
pairs.zh: 使用适合且经校准的设备检测氧气、可燃气体及相关有毒气体，并遵守经批准的检测程序。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: And you must have enough ventilation.
pairs.zh: 你必须有足够的通风。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: How do you ventilate without a fan?
pairs.zh: 没有风扇怎么通风？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Use the ventilation arrangements specified by the approved entry procedure.
pairs.zh: 应采用经批准的进入程序所规定的通风安排。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Natural ventilation alone does not prove that the atmosphere is safe.
pairs.zh: 仅有自然通风并不能证明气氛安全。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Before entry, complete the required ventilation and atmosphere tests. Coal can catch fire.
pairs.zh: 进入前，应完成规定的通风和气氛检测。煤炭可能着火。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Fire consumes oxygen and can increase the concentration of carbon dioxide.
pairs.zh: 燃烧会消耗氧气，并可能提高二氧化碳浓度。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: That's scary. Yes, it is.
pairs.zh: 这是可怕的。是的，它是。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Two seafarers died in a lower stool space because of oxygen deficiency.
pairs.zh: 两名海员曾因缺氧死于下底凳内部空间。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Atmosphere testing, an attendant and appropriate rescue preparations are essential parts of the approved enclosed-space entry procedure.
pairs.zh: 气氛检测、现场监护人员及适当的救援准备都是经批准的封闭处所进入程序的重要部分。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Do you know what this is?
pairs.zh: 你知道这是什么吗？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: It is a chain stopper.
pairs.zh: 这是一个制链器。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: When the vessel is at anchor, the chain stopper is used to secure the anchor cable.
pairs.zh: 船舶锚泊时，制链器用于固定锚链。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Drop anchor.
pairs.zh: 抛锚。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: The anchor is aweigh.
pairs.zh: 锚已离底。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: It's easy but dangerous.
pairs.zh: 这很容易，但很危险。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Use the agreed method for handling the messenger rope, the mooring line and the wire rope.
pairs.zh: 处理引缆、系泊缆和钢丝绳时，须采用已商定的方法。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Keep clear of running lines and possible snagging points at the Panama fairlead.
pairs.zh: 避开正在移动的缆绳和巴拿马导缆孔处可能卡阻的位置。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: What do we do then?
pairs.zh: 那我们该怎么办呢？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: You must follow the Chief Officer's directions and watch out for running ropes.
pairs.zh: 你必须听从大副的指示，小心跑绳。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Keep clear of damaged lines and be sure to keep an eye on them.
pairs.zh: 避开受损缆绳，一定要留意它们。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: At school, we were told that taking a rope stopper was very dangerous.
pairs.zh: 在学校里，我们被告知使用缆绳止缆索是非常危险的。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Make sure to handle a rope stopper only after the Chief Officer tells you it is safe.
pairs.zh: 只有在大副告诉你缆绳止缆索是安全的情况下，你才能使用它。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Never decide on your own that the operation is safe.
pairs.zh: 不要擅自认定作业已经安全。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Many seamen have been injured in this situation, and many have lost their lives.
pairs.zh: 许多海员在这种情况下受伤，许多人失去了生命。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: I understand. Is the same true for tug lines?
pairs.zh: 我明白了。拖船缆也是如此吗？

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: During this port operation, the vessel has a high freeboard, which means that the height from the deck to the tugboat is very high.
pairs.zh: 在这次港内作业中，本船干舷较高，这意味着从甲板到拖船的高度非常高。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Use the towline specified for the operation.
pairs.zh: 使用本次作业规定的拖缆。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Use the specified messenger line and equipment when passing the towline.
pairs.zh: 传递拖缆时，使用规定的引缆和设备。

pairs.title: 甲板工作安全须知
pairs.en: Work with the assigned team using the agreed communication signals, and follow the Chief Officer's orders.
pairs.zh: 与指定作业人员配合，使用已商定的通信信号，听从大副的命令。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Mike, a service boat is coming.
pairs.zh: 迈克，一艘服务船来了。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Lower the accommodation ladder on the starboard side.
pairs.zh: 放下右舷舷梯。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: It was lowered on the port side.
pairs.zh: 它是从左舷放下来的。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: The port side is no good!
pairs.zh: 左舷不好！

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: There is a strong wind and the waves are high.
pairs.zh: 风很大，浪也很大。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: You must use the starboard side.
pairs.zh: 你必须使用右舷。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: It is sheltered from the wind and the waves are not as big there.
pairs.zh: 那里避风，海浪也没有那么大。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Yes, sir. I will lower it there.
pairs.zh: 好的，先生，我会放右舷舷梯。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: There appears to be a member of a crewmember's family on the service boat.
pairs.zh: 服务艇上似乎有一名船员家属。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: I will put on the required personal protective equipment before going down.
pairs.zh: 下去之前，我会穿戴规定的个人防护用品。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Prepare the specified pneumatic light to illuminate the transfer area.
pairs.zh: 准备规定的气动照明灯，照亮人员转移区域。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: The Bridge's wing lights might be bright enough.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台两翼的灯光可能够亮了。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: You can use it as soon as you open the air valve.
pairs.zh: 你一打开气阀就可以用了。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: OK, stop.
pairs.zh: 好了，停止。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: The waves are high, so I'll lower it when the boat comes closer.
pairs.zh: 海浪很高，等船靠近我再放低。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Second Officer, the service boat and the landing platform are nearly level.
pairs.zh: 二副，服务艇与登乘平台几乎处于同一高度。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Can the personnel transfer proceed under the agreed procedure?
pairs.zh: 可以按已商定的程序进行人员转移了吗？

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Are there guests on board?
pairs.zh: 船上有客人吗？

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Yes, two women.
pairs.zh: 是的，两个女人。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: You help them onto the boat, and I'll help them from here.
pairs.zh: 你帮她们上艇，我在这边协助她们。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Tell them to take their time.
pairs.zh: 告诉她们慢慢来。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Explain the agreed transfer procedure and monitor the boat's movement, including its rise and fall with the waves.
pairs.zh: 说明已商定的人员转移程序，并监控服务艇的运动，包括服务艇随波浪上下起伏的情况。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: And don't let them carry their luggage.
pairs.zh: 别让她们拿行李。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: I will give you a rope later so we can carry the bags up.
pairs.zh: 我一会儿会给你一根绳子，这样我们就可以把袋子搬上去了。

pairs.title: 它船靠本轮 - 服务艇
pairs.en: Yes, sir. Let's go!
pairs.zh: 是的，先生，我们走吧！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: The sea is a little rough today, is it not?
pairs.zh: 今天海面有些风浪，对吗？

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: You are up bright and early this morning!
pairs.zh: 你今天起得真早！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: We are in the middle of the monsoon season.
pairs.zh: 现在正值季风季节。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: The waves are very big.
pairs.zh: 海浪很大。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Be extra careful in the stairway.
pairs.zh: 在楼梯上要格外小心。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Yes, I'll hold on firmly to the handrail and be very careful.
pairs.zh: 是的，我会紧紧抓住扶手，非常小心。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Just a moment!
pairs.zh: 等一下！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: That's dangerous.
pairs.zh: 这是危险的。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: When you hold onto the handrail with your right hand forward, your left hand should be behind you, like this.
pairs.zh: 当你右手向前抓住扶手时，你的左手应该放在身后，像这样。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: It's easier for you to keep your balance that way and not slip.
pairs.zh: 这样你更容易保持平衡而不滑倒。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: I see. Like this!
pairs.zh: 我明白了。像这样！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: You're right!
pairs.zh: 你是对的！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: It's also dangerous to carry tools when you climb stairs.
pairs.zh: 爬楼梯时携带工具也很危险。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: You should put them in your pockets or in a tool bag tied around you.
pairs.zh: 你应该把它们放在口袋里或绑在身边的工具包里。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: I understand.
pairs.zh: 我明白了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: My flashlight is in my left pocket, and my rag and wrench are in my right pocket.
pairs.zh: 我的手电筒在我左边的口袋里，我的抹布和扳手在我的右侧口袋里。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Also, take your time so you don't slip and fall.
pairs.zh: 还有，慢慢来，这样你就不会滑倒了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Be careful where you step, and always watch your head.
pairs.zh: 小心你的脚步，时刻注意你的头。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Yes, sir. By the way, when I was in the store looking for some spare parts, I saw a big wooden box about two meters long, 50 centimeters wide and one meter high.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。顺便说一下，当我在储藏室找一些备件时，我看到一个大约两米长的大木箱，宽50厘米，高1米。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: What's it for, and what's inside of it?
pairs.zh: 它是做什么用的，里面有什么？

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: It's an old valve that has to be landed at the next dry dock.
pairs.zh: 这是一个旧阀门，必须在下一个进坞时送岸。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: We replaced it with a new one during our last voyage.
pairs.zh: 上次航行时，我们换了一台新的。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Be careful!
pairs.zh: 小心！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: The ship is rocking.
pairs.zh: 船在摇晃。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Don't drop your dishes.
pairs.zh: 别把盘子掉在地上。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: It must be tough to cook on a day like this.
pairs.zh: 在这样的天气里做饭一定很辛苦。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Now I know why you always wear safety shoes in the galley.
pairs.zh: 现在我知道你为什么在厨房里总是穿安全鞋了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Yes. Even in the galley we have to be careful.
pairs.zh: 是的。即使在厨房里，我们也要小心。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: You could slip and drop a knife on your foot or a load of dishes on the floor, especially when the sea is as rough as it is now.
pairs.zh: 你可能滑倒，把刀掉在脚上，或者一堆盘子掉在地板上，特别是像现在这样的大浪状态下。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: imagine what could happen if we were barefoot.
pairs.zh: 想象一下如果我们光着脚会发生什么。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Especially with all of those hot dishes you serve.
pairs.zh: 尤其是你做的那些热菜。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Exactly. And we can't see the waves like you can outside.
pairs.zh: 完全正确。我们不能像你们在外面那样看到海浪。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Oh, the sea off Durban in South Africa is really terrible!
pairs.zh: 哦，南非德班附近的海真是太可怕了！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: But come monsoons or typhoons, everyone expects their meal to be ready.
pairs.zh: 但一旦季风或台风来袭，每个人都希望饭准备好了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: We need to work safely while preparing meals for everyone.
pairs.zh: 为大家准备饭菜时，我们仍须确保作业安全。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: How do you stop the dishes from sliding off the shelves?
pairs.zh: 你怎样防止盘子从架子上滑下来？

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: That is a problem.
pairs.zh: 这是一个问题。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: When we are in rough seas, sometimes the dishes even fly out of the deep sink, so we can't put the dishes anywhere when the sea is that rough.
pairs.zh: 遇到恶劣海况时，餐具有时甚至会从深水槽中颠出来，所以遇到这么大的风浪，餐具不能随意摆放。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: It must be even worse on a small ship.
pairs.zh: 在小船上肯定更糟。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Yes, then we wouldn't even be able to sit down and eat normally.
pairs.zh: 是的，那样我们就不能坐下来正常吃饭了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Anyway, we all have to be careful when the ship pitches and rolls.
pairs.zh: 不管怎么说，船舶纵摇、横摇时，大家都必须小心。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: What happened?
pairs.zh: 发生了什么事？

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: I heard a loud noise!
pairs.zh: 我听到一声巨响！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: That was close!
pairs.zh: 好险啊！

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: I was standing on a chair trying to change a light bulb, and the chair moved and I fell down.
pairs.zh: 我当时正站在椅子上换灯泡，椅子动了一下，我摔倒了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: These waves are really big.
pairs.zh: 这些浪真的很大。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Are you hurt?
pairs.zh: 你受伤了吗？

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: I'm OK, but I fell hard on my arm.
pairs.zh: 我还好，不过手臂摔得很重。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: And the light bulb is smashed.
pairs.zh: 灯泡被打碎了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: I'll help you clean up.
pairs.zh: 我来帮你打扫。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: Thanks, but I'll take care of it.
pairs.zh: 谢谢，不过我会处理的。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: It was stupid of me to stand on a chair in such rough seas.
pairs.zh: 在这样波涛汹涌的海面上站在椅子上，我真愚蠢。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: That reminds me of the Second Officer.
pairs.zh: 这让我想起了二副。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: He went on his watch, and when he came back to his cabin, his bottle of whisky had fallen onto the floor and broken.
pairs.zh: 他值班去了，当他回到他的房间时，他的威士忌酒瓶已摔到地板上打碎了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: He couldn't sleep because of the smell.
pairs.zh: 他因为气味而无法入睡。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: That's too bad. Actually, the sea wasn't so rough at midnight when the Second Officer started his watch, but it was terrible by morning.
pairs.zh: 那太糟糕了。实际上，当二副开始值班时，午夜的海面并没有那么汹涌，但到了早上就糟透了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: The Second Officer was worrying about his bottle of whiskey, but he couldn't return to his cabin while on duty.
pairs.zh: 二副正在担心他那瓶威士忌，但是他不能在值班时回到他的房间。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: He also said that he lost his favorite pen because of the ship rocking so much.
pairs.zh: 他还说，船摇晃得太厉害，把他最喜欢的钢笔弄丢了。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: How did that happen?
pairs.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: After writing to his wife last night, he left the pen on his desk.
pairs.zh: 昨晚他给妻子写完信后，把钢笔留在了书桌上。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: It rolled off the desk and fell into the trash can.
pairs.zh: 它从桌子上滚下来，掉进了垃圾桶里。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: He threw away his garbage this morning not knowing the pen was inside.
pairs.zh: 今天早上他把垃圾扔了，却不知道里面有笔。

pairs.title: 日常安全 - 恶劣天气
pairs.en: What a shame!
pairs.zh: 真可惜！

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Third Officer, will you give me some liquid soap for the toilet in the wheel house?
pairs.zh: 三副，请给我一些液体肥皂，用在驾驶台的厕所里。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Sure, I'll go and get some.
pairs.zh: 当然，我去拿一些。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: It goes quickly because everybody always washes their hands.
pairs.zh: 大家经常洗手，所以洗手液用得很快。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Well, we are always worried about food poisoning and infections on board, so the steward crew wash their hands before they start cooking.
pairs.zh: 我们总是担心船上的食物中毒和感染，所以厨师长服务员在开始做饭前要洗手。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: The Chief Cook washes his hands whenever he enters the galley.
pairs.zh: 厨师长每次进入厨房都洗手。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: That makes sense.
pairs.zh: 这说得通。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Once, a mess boy was cleaning the galley with his pants rolled up.
pairs.zh: 有一次，一个服务生卷着裤子打扫厨房。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: When he finished cleaning, he rolled his pants down and served a dish without washing his hands first.
pairs.zh: 当他打扫完后，他把裤子放了下来，没有先洗手就上菜了。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: He got into a lot of trouble for that.
pairs.zh: 他因此惹了很多麻烦。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Sanitation is important on board.
pairs.zh: 船上的卫生很重要。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: We always have to be careful.
pairs.zh: 我们总是要小心。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Some infections can spread through contaminated hands or contact.
pairs.zh: 有些感染可通过受污染的手或接触传播。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: There is no doctor on board so we must all pay attention to our hygiene.
pairs.zh: 船上没有医生，所以我们都必须注意卫生。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Recently, several people developed an infection.
pairs.zh: 最近，有几个人出现了感染。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Proper handwashing with soap is important.
pairs.zh: 用肥皂正确洗手很重要。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: An outbreak on board could be serious.
pairs.zh: 船上发生感染暴发可能带来严重后果。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: We should follow the vessel's hygiene procedures.
pairs.zh: 我们应遵守本船卫生程序。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I'll make sure to always wash my hands.
pairs.zh: 我一定要经常洗手。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I'm tired of starting cleaning at 6:30 every morning.
pairs.zh: 我厌倦了每天早上六点半开始打扫卫生。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Did you say something?
pairs.zh: 你说什么了吗？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: No, I was just talking to myself.
pairs.zh: 不，我只是在自言自语。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: How do you think the rest of the crew would feel if the whole place was dirty when they got up?
pairs.zh: 你觉得其他船员起床后发现整个地方都很脏会怎么想？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: You're right.
pairs.zh: 你是对的。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Since we clean every day, it doesn't get too dirty.
pairs.zh: 因为我们每天打扫，它不会太脏。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: If we only cleaned when it was very dirty, it would be a lot harder.
pairs.zh: 如果我们只在它很脏的时候清洗，那就难多了。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: We clean this area every day, but what about the rest of the boat?
pairs.zh: 我们每天都打扫这个区域，那船的其他部分呢？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: We clean the walls and ceilings in the General Office, too.
pairs.zh: 我们也打扫办公室的墙壁和天花板。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: You may not notice easily, but tar and nicotine from cigarettes make walls and ceilings turn ugly yellow.
pairs.zh: 你可能不容易注意到，但是香烟中的焦油和尼古丁会使墙壁和天花板变成难看的黄色。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Yes, that's right.
pairs.zh: 是的，没错。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I've noticed lots of oil stains in the corridors.
pairs.zh: 我注意到走廊上有很多油渍。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Well, the ship is our home and a clean ship is a safe ship.
pairs.zh: 船是我们的家，干净的船才是安全的船。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I understand.
pairs.zh: 我明白了。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: If the whole place was dirty, if the paint was peeling off, if it was rusty all over, and if there were things lying around, I would feel like I was on a rotten ship.
pairs.zh: 如果整个地方都很脏，如果油漆脱落了，如果船上到处锈迹斑斑，如果周围有东西乱放，我会觉得自己待在一艘破败的船上。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: And I wouldn't care about it.
pairs.zh: 那样我也可能不再爱护它。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Exactly.
pairs.zh: 完全正确。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Feeling good about the ship makes you feel good about yourself.
pairs.zh: 对这艘船感觉良好会让你对自己感觉良好。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: First, start sweeping. Mike, start vacuuming A-Deck.
pairs.zh: 首先，开始扫地。迈克，开始吸尘A甲板。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: As for the rest of you, go to A-Deck and get the buckets, sponges, mops, and liquid soap.
pairs.zh: 至于你们其余的人，去A甲板拿桶来，海绵、拖把和液体肥皂。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Then clean the walls and ceilings.
pairs.zh: 然后打扫墙壁和天花板。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Wipe the fluorescent lamps, too.
pairs.zh: 把荧光灯也擦干净。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Yes, sir. What should I use for the tough oily spots?
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。我应该用什么来对付顽固的油性斑点？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Use the approved detergent at the specified dilution and wipe the surface thoroughly.
pairs.zh: 按规定稀释比例使用认可的清洁剂，彻底擦拭表面。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: If the stain remains, check the approved cleaning procedure before using another product.
pairs.zh: 如污渍仍未去除，改用其他产品前先查阅经批准的清洁程序。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: OK. I'll try that.
pairs.zh: 好的。我来试试。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: After washing with soap, change the water and rinse the whole place with clean water.
pairs.zh: 用肥皂洗净后，换水，用清水冲洗整个地方。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: That gets rid of all the dirt.
pairs.zh: 这样可以清除所有的污垢。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I'll change the water now.
pairs.zh: 我现在就去换水。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: After you finish cleaning the walls and ceiling, you must mop the floor.
pairs.zh: 你打扫完墙壁和天花板后，你必须拖地。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Remember to change the water frequently.
pairs.zh: 记得经常换水。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: For oily or greasy areas, use the approved cleaning product as directed, and then mop again.
pairs.zh: 有油污的地方，应按说明使用认可的清洁用品，然后再拖地。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Should we polish the doorknobs?
pairs.zh: 我们要把门把手擦亮吗？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: After you finish mopping.
pairs.zh: 你拖地完之后。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Cadet,
pairs.zh: 实习生，

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I finished mopping the floor.
pairs.zh: 我把地拖完了。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Shall I go down one deck?
pairs.zh: 我下一层好吗？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Not yet.
pairs.zh: 先别下去。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: We should take a break.
pairs.zh: 我们应该休息一下。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Mike, will you go to the deck office and make some coffee for us?
pairs.zh: 迈克，你能去甲板办公室给我们煮点咖啡吗？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Yes, sir.
pairs.zh: 是的，先生。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I'll carry down these sponges to the next deck on my way to the deck office.
pairs.zh: 我会在去甲板办公室的路上把这些海绵带到下一层甲板。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Thank you.
pairs.zh: 谢谢你。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Good morning. Are you still sleeping?
pairs.zh: 早上好。你还在睡觉吗？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Good morning, sir.
pairs.zh: 早上好，先生。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: No, I got up at 8 o'clock this morning.
pairs.zh: 不，我今天早上8点起床。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I was just reading in bed.
pairs.zh: 我只是躺在床上看书。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: You should go and have breakfast now.
pairs.zh: 你现在应该去吃早饭了。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Wow, your cabin is a real pigpen.
pairs.zh: 哇，你的房间真是个猪圈。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: You should clean it up.
pairs.zh: 你应该把它清理干净。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Today is a good day for that.
pairs.zh: 今天是一个很好的日子。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I was thinking of doing that myself.
pairs.zh: 我自己也正打算打扫一下。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: The vessel is due for a ship sanitation inspection in China.
pairs.zh: 本船将在中国接受船舶卫生检查。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: So you must clean everywhere, even under the bed.
pairs.zh: 所以你必须到处打扫，甚至在床底下。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Make sure you dust, too.
pairs.zh: 你也要掸掸灰尘。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: What do they check during the inspection?
pairs.zh: 他们在检查时都检查什么？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: They check if the ship meets the standard rules for sanitation.
pairs.zh: 他们检查船舶是否符合卫生标准。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: For example, if they find cockroaches or mouse droppings, the ship will fail the inspection.
pairs.zh: 例如，如果他们发现蟑螂或老鼠的粪便，这艘船不会通过检查。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Do they check the cabins?
pairs.zh: 他们也检查住舱吗？

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Yes. The inspection includes the accommodation spaces.
pairs.zh: 是的。检查范围包括生活区。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: They always check the drawers under the beds to see if there is mouse excrement.
pairs.zh: 他们总是检查床下的抽屉，看是否有老鼠屎。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: So you must keep them clean.
pairs.zh: 所以你必须保持它们干净。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I understand.
pairs.zh: 我明白了。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: I will vacuum the whole cabin today.
pairs.zh: 今天我要用吸尘器清扫整个房间。

pairs.title: 日常卫生与清洁
pairs.en: Good. A clean room is better for your health.
pairs.zh: 好。洁净的房间对你的健康有好处。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: What's that floating in the water?
pairs.zh: 漂在水里的是什么？

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: It looks like oil, doesn't it?
pairs.zh: 它看起来像油，不是吗？

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: That's terrible!
pairs.zh: 那太可怕了！

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Who would do such a thing?
pairs.zh: 谁会做这种事？

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: It may be a discharge from another vessel, but we cannot identify the source from here.
pairs.zh: 可能是其他船舶的排放，但我们无法在这里确认来源。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: How awful!
pairs.zh: 多么可怕啊！

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Do you think that it will wash away?
pairs.zh: 你认为它会被冲走吗？

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: In the deep sea, everyone thinks that everything will wash away, but thinking like that is spoiling the sea.
pairs.zh: 在深海中，每个人都认为一切都会被冲走，但这样的想法是在糟蹋大海。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Nature is being destroyed.
pairs.zh: 自然正在被破坏。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: And it's not only because of oil spills.
pairs.zh: 这不仅仅是因为油泄漏。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Yes, I saw a lot of plastic bottles floating around, too.
pairs.zh: 是的，我还看到很多塑料瓶漂浮在水面上。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Follow the port's waste-discharge restrictions.
pairs.zh: 遵守港口的废物排放限制。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: MARPOL regulates the discharge of oil and oily mixtures.
pairs.zh: MARPOL对油及含油混合物的排放作出规定。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: The port authority prohibits dumping garbage overboard.
pairs.zh: 港口当局禁止向舷外倾倒垃圾。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Oily bilge water and ship-generated garbage must be managed under the applicable requirements.
pairs.zh: 含油舱底水及船舶产生的垃圾须按适用要求管理。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Our disposal standards on board meet these rules.
pairs.zh: 我们船上的处理标准符合这些规定。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Additional discharge restrictions may apply in this coastal State's waters.
pairs.zh: 该沿海国水域内可能还有其他排放限制。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: So we should never throw garbage into the sea.
pairs.zh: 所以我们不应该把垃圾扔进海里。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Exactly, not even a beer can or a cigarette butt.
pairs.zh: 没错，连啤酒罐和烟头都不行。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Is your washing finished?
pairs.zh: 你的衣服洗完了吗？

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: It will be soon. I'll tell you when it's done.
pairs.zh: 很快就会了。完成后我会告诉你的。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: It's now in the spin cycle so it'll just be one or two more minutes.
pairs.zh: 现在正在脱水，还要一两分钟。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: I saw someone rinsing something under running water.
pairs.zh: 我看到有人在流水下冲洗东西。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Isn't that wasteful?
pairs.zh: 这不是浪费吗？

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Even though the evaporator produces fresh water, we should still conserve it.
pairs.zh: 即使造水装置能生产淡水，我们仍应节约使用。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Right. I also try not to use too much detergent.
pairs.zh: 正确的。我也尽量不要用太多的洗涤剂。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: That way it takes less fresh water to rinse my laundry.
pairs.zh: 这样漂洗衣物就能少用一些淡水。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: I bought this detergent in China.
pairs.zh: 我在中国买了这种洗涤剂。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: It's really strong so just one little scoop does the job!
pairs.zh: 它真的很浓，所以只要一小勺就够了！

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Follow the approved environmental procedures when using cleaning products.
pairs.zh: 使用清洁用品时，应遵守经批准的环保程序。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Use products suitable for the task and follow the disposal instructions.
pairs.zh: 使用适合该任务的产品，并遵守处置说明。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Next time we stop in China, I'll buy some, too.
pairs.zh: 下次我们在中国停留时，我也要买一些。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: OK, I'm done.
pairs.zh: 好了，我做完了。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: I'll hang up my clothes now.
pairs.zh: 我现在要把衣服挂起来。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: Wow! You have a lot of clothes to wash!
pairs.zh: 哇！你有很多衣服要洗！

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: I've been very busy and I haven't been doing much washing.
pairs.zh: 我一直很忙，没怎么洗衣服。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: I do not have anything clean to wear.
pairs.zh: 我没有干净衣服可穿了。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: You have to stay clean or you'll get sick.
pairs.zh: 你必须保持清洁，否则你会生病的。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: No matter how busy you are, you should always wash your clothes.
pairs.zh: 不管你有多忙，你应该经常洗衣服。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: I know. I was just lazy.
pairs.zh: 我知道。我只是懒了。

pairs.title: 防污染
pairs.en: I won't let it happen again.
pairs.zh: 我不会再让这种事发生了。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: You shouldn't eat so quickly!
pairs.zh: 你不应该吃得这么快！

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: I'm starving.
pairs.zh: 我饿死了。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: And this food is so good that I can't help it.
pairs.zh: 这食物太好吃了，我忍不住要吃。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: In China, we say that chewing your food well keeps you in good health.
pairs.zh: 在中国，我们说好好咀嚼食物能让你保持健康。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: I see.
pairs.zh: 我明白了。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: Don't you like vegetables?
pairs.zh: 你不喜欢吃蔬菜吗？

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: Yes, I do.
pairs.zh: 是的，我喜欢。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: But the meat here is so good that I only eat meat and fish.
pairs.zh: 但是这里的肉太好吃了，所以我只吃肉和鱼。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: It's easier for us to serve meat and fish on board.
pairs.zh: 我们在船上供应肉和鱼比较方便。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: It is harder to preserve vegetables.
pairs.zh: 保存蔬菜更难了。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: And it's wasteful to have all these leftover vegetables.
pairs.zh: 这么多蔬菜剩下不吃，也很浪费。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: I have heard different opinions about whether meat is more nutritious than vegetables.
pairs.zh: 关于肉类是否比蔬菜更有营养，我听过不同看法。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: Different foods provide different nutrients.
pairs.zh: 不同食物提供不同的营养素。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: The important point is to eat a varied, balanced diet.
pairs.zh: 重要的是饮食多样、营养均衡。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: A balanced diet is important.
pairs.zh: 均衡饮食很重要。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: So I should eat some vegetables, too?
pairs.zh: 所以我也应该吃一些蔬菜吗？

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: Definitely. Good health depends on a balanced diet. A balanced diet includes a suitable variety of foods, including vegetables.
pairs.zh: 当然。身体健康有赖于均衡饮食。均衡饮食应包括适当种类的食物，其中包括蔬菜。

pairs.title: 日常饮食用语
pairs.en: I know. Moderation, eating balanced meals, and exercising regularly are the basics of good health.
pairs.zh: 我知道。适度，均衡饮食，经常锻炼是身体健康的基础。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: Excuse me, Second Officer.
pairs.zh: 打扰一下，二副。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: I have a stomachache.
pairs.zh: 我肚子疼。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: Can you give me some medicine?
pairs.zh: 你能给我一些药吗？

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: Let me see. Where does it hurt?
pairs.zh: 让我看看。哪里疼？

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: Here, in the lower part of my right side.
pairs.zh: 这里，右下腹。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: It's painful.
pairs.zh: 很疼。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: When did the pain start?
pairs.zh: 什么时候开始疼的？

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: This morning.
pairs.zh: 今天早上。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: I have been trying to eat well and I have been chewing my food more carefully under the advice of the Chief Officer.
pairs.zh: 我一直尽量规律饮食，并按大副的建议细嚼慢咽。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: Do you have diarrhea?
pairs.zh: 你腹泻吗？

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: No, not at all.
pairs.zh: 不，一点也不。

pairs.title: 身体生病就医
pairs.en: Do you have a fever?
pairs.zh: 你发烧吗？

pairs.title: 备车与完车
pairs.en: Engine room, this is bridge. Stand by engine.
pairs.zh: 机舱，这里是驾驶台。备车。

pairs.title: 备车与完车
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Stand by engine, understood.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。备车，收到。

pairs.title: 备车与完车
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Engine is ready.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。主机备妥。

pairs.title: 备车与完车
pairs.en: Engine room, this is bridge. Finished with engines.
pairs.zh: 机舱，这里是驾驶台。完车。

pairs.title: 备车与完车
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Finished with engines, understood.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。完车，收到。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Dead slow ahead.
pairs.zh: 微速前进。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Dead slow ahead, engine is dead slow ahead.
pairs.zh: 微速前进，主机微速前进。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Half astern.
pairs.zh: 半速后退。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Half astern, engine is half astern.
pairs.zh: 半速后退，主机半速后退。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Full ahead.
pairs.zh: 全速前进。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Full ahead, engine is full ahead.
pairs.zh: 全速前进，主机全速前进。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Stop engine.
pairs.zh: 停车。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Stop engine, engine is stopped.
pairs.zh: 停车，主机已停。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Emergency stop.
pairs.zh: 紧急停车。

pairs.title: 车钟操纵指令
pairs.en: Emergency stop, engine is stopped immediately.
pairs.zh: 紧急停车，主机立即停车。

pairs.title: 设备故障报告
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Main engine lube oil pressure low alarm.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。主机滑油低压报警。

pairs.title: 设备故障报告
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Generator No.2 breakdown.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。2号发电机故障。

pairs.title: 设备故障报告
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Cooling water high temperature.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。冷却水高温。

pairs.title: 设备故障报告
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Fuel oil pipe leakage.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。燃油管泄漏。

pairs.title: 设备故障报告
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Fire in engine room, near boiler.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。机舱失火，锅炉附近。

pairs.title: 设备故障报告
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Serious bilge water accumulation.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。舱底水严重积聚。

pairs.title: 设备故障报告
pairs.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Need emergency repair immediately.
pairs.zh: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。需立即应急修理。

pairs.title: 巡检与维护
pairs.en: I have made rounds of engine room. All parameters normal.
pairs.zh: 我已完成机舱巡检，所有参数正常。

pairs.title: 巡检与维护
pairs.en: No abnormal noise, no leakage found.
pairs.zh: 未发现异常噪音和泄漏。

pairs.title: 巡检与维护
pairs.en: All pumps and motors running well.
pairs.zh: 所有泵浦和电机运行良好。

pairs.title: 巡检与维护
pairs.en: I am cleaning the fuel oil filter.
pairs.zh: 我正在清洗燃油滤器。

pairs.title: 巡检与维护
pairs.en: I will change the lube oil of main engine.
pairs.zh: 我要更换主机滑油。

pairs.title: 巡检与维护
pairs.en: Please stand by. I am testing the alarm system.
pairs.zh: 请稍候。我正在测试报警系统。

pairs.title: 交接班
pairs.en: I am taking over duty. Any special orders?
pairs.zh: 我来接班，有特殊指令吗？

pairs.title: 交接班
pairs.en: Any problems with the machinery?
pairs.zh: 机械设备有问题吗？

pairs.title: 交接班
pairs.en: All machinery running normally. No special orders.
pairs.zh: 所有机械运行正常，无特殊指令。

pairs.title: 交接班
pairs.en: Generator No.1 under maintenance, No.2 and 3 in operation.
pairs.zh: 1号发电机在保养，2、3号运行中。

pairs.title: 交接班
pairs.en: Please monitor main engine exhaust temperature closely.
pairs.zh: 请密切监控主机排气温度。

pairs.title: 交接班
pairs.en: Handover completed.
pairs.zh: 交接完毕。

pairs.title: 交接班
pairs.en: Understood. I will take over now.
pairs.zh: 明白，我现在接班。

pairs.title: PSC检查沟通
pairs.en: Show me the engine logbook.
pairs.zh: 给我看轮机日志。

pairs.title: PSC检查沟通
pairs.en: Here you are.
pairs.zh: 给您。

pairs.title: PSC检查沟通
pairs.en: When did you test the fire pump?
pairs.zh: 你们何时测试的消防泵？

pairs.title: PSC检查沟通
pairs.en: We tested it yesterday, everything in good order.
pairs.zh: 昨天测试的，一切正常。

pairs.title: PSC检查沟通
pairs.en: Any deficiencies recently?
pairs.zh: 近期有缺陷吗？

pairs.title: PSC检查沟通
pairs.en: No deficiencies found.
pairs.zh: 未发现缺陷。

pairs.title: 气象报告接收
pairs.en: Have you received the latest NAVTEX weather report?
pairs.zh: 你收到最新的 NAVTEX 气象报告了吗？

pairs.title: 气象报告接收
pairs.en: The synopsis shows a deep depression centred at 45°N 160°E, moving east at 25 knots.
pairs.zh: 天气形势显示一个深低压中心位于北纬45度、东经160度，正以25节向东移动。

pairs.title: 气象报告接收
pairs.en: Are there any gale warnings for our area?
pairs.zh: 我们海域有大风警告吗？

pairs.title: 气象报告接收
pairs.en: Gale warning is issued for area east of 150°E, with winds up to Force 8 to 9 and sea state becoming rough.
pairs.zh: 东经150度以东海域有大风警告，风力达8到9级，海况将变得恶劣。

pairs.title: 气象报告接收
pairs.en: What is the forecast for the next 24 hours?
pairs.zh: 未来24小时预报如何？

pairs.title: 气象报告接收
pairs.en: Winds expected to increase further, visibility moderate to poor in rain showers.
pairs.zh: 风力预计进一步加强，能见度中等至不良，有阵雨。

pairs.title: 气象报告接收
pairs.en: Keep monitoring the weather fax and update me if anything changes.
pairs.zh: 继续接收并查看气象传真图，有变化及时报告。

pairs.title: 台风避让讨论
pairs.en: Captain, the latest typhoon warning shows Tropical Storm 'MILA' has intensified into a Severe Tropical Storm, currently at 18°N 125°E, moving NW at 12 knots.
pairs.zh: 船长，最新台风警报显示热带风暴'米拉'已增强为强热带风暴，目前位于北纬18度东经125度，向西北移动，速度12节。

pairs.title: 台风避让讨论
pairs.en: Plot its position and projected track on the chart. How far is it from our intended route?
pairs.zh: 在海图上标出它的位置和预测路径。距离我们计划航线有多远？

pairs.title: 台风避让讨论
pairs.en: About 300 nautical miles to the southeast. The forecast track shows it may cross our route in 48 hours.
pairs.zh: 大约东南方向300海里。预报路径显示它可能在48小时后穿越我们的航线。

pairs.title: 台风避让讨论
pairs.en: The storm may create dangerous conditions along our route. Assess our position, sea room and the forecast before deciding on an alteration.
pairs.zh: 风暴可能使计划航线出现危险海况。决定改向前，先评估本船位置、海上余地及预报。

pairs.title: 台风避让讨论
pairs.en: I agree. We should also reduce speed to avoid heavy pounding and secure all loose gear on deck.
pairs.zh: 同意。应该减速以避免剧烈颠簸，固定甲板上所有松动设备。

pairs.title: 台风避让讨论
pairs.en: Should I inform the company and send a diversion report?
pairs.zh: 需要通知公司并发送改航报告吗？

pairs.title: 台风避让讨论
pairs.en: Yes. Prepare a message with our new course, speed, and ETA changes. Safety first.
pairs.zh: 是的。准备一份电文，写明我们的新航向、速度和预计到港时间变化。安全第一。

pairs.title: 雾航与能见度不良
pairs.en: Visibility has dropped to less than 1 nautical mile. Fog is setting in fast.
pairs.zh: 能见度降至不到1海里。雾来得很快。

pairs.title: 雾航与能见度不良
pairs.en: This looks like advection fog - warm moist air over the cold current. Sound the fog signal as per COLREGS.
pairs.zh: 看起来像平流雾——暖湿空气经过冷水流。按照《国际海上避碰规则》鸣放雾号。

pairs.title: 雾航与能见度不良
pairs.en: Shall we verify both radars and post an additional lookout forward?
pairs.zh: 是否检查确认两部雷达的状态，并在船首增派瞭望人员？

pairs.title: 雾航与能见度不良
pairs.en: Use both radars at appropriate range scales, maintain a proper lookout and proceed at a safe speed.
pairs.zh: 两部雷达采用适当量程，保持正规瞭望，并以安全航速航行。

pairs.title: 雾航与能见度不良
pairs.en: The sea surface temperature has dropped 3 degrees in the last hour. That explains the fog formation.
pairs.zh: 海面水温在过去一小时内下降了3度。这就解释了雾的形成原因。

pairs.title: 雾航与能见度不良
pairs.en: Check the barometer and the latest forecast. Do not infer how long the fog will last from pressure alone.
pairs.zh: 查看气压计和最新预报，不要只根据气压推断雾会持续多久。

pairs.title: 雾航与能见度不良
pairs.en: Understood. I will keep monitoring the radar and report any contacts immediately.
pairs.zh: 明白。我会持续监控雷达，发现目标立即报告。

pairs.title: 气象观测与记录
pairs.en: It's time for the 0800 weather observation. Let's go to the bridge wing.
pairs.zh: 到0800时气象观测时间了，我们去驾驶台翼部。

pairs.title: 气象观测与记录
pairs.en: Wind is from 230 degrees at 22 knots, gusting 28. Cloud cover is 7 oktas, mainly Cumulus and Stratocumulus.
pairs.zh: 风从230度方向吹来，风速22节，阵风28节。云量7/8，主要为积云和层积云。

pairs.title: 气象观测与记录
pairs.en: What is the visibility and present weather?
pairs.zh: 能见度和当前天气如何？

pairs.title: 气象观测与记录
pairs.en: Visibility is 8 nautical miles. Light drizzle observed. Air temperature 15°C, sea surface temperature 12°C.
pairs.zh: 能见度8海里。观测到轻微毛毛雨。气温15摄氏度，海面水温12摄氏度。

pairs.title: 气象观测与记录
pairs.en: Barometric pressure reading is 1012.5 hPa, falling slowly at 0.3 hPa per hour. Dew point is 10°C.
pairs.zh: 气压读数为1012.5百帕，缓慢下降，每小时下降0.3百帕。露点10摄氏度。

pairs.title: 气象观测与记录
pairs.en: Record everything in the weather logbook. The falling pressure may indicate an approaching low pressure system.
pairs.zh: 把所有这些记录到气象日志中。气压下降可能表明有低压系统正在靠近。

pairs.title: 气象观测与记录
pairs.en: I'll also compare with the latest weather fax to see if the forecast matches our observations.
pairs.zh: 我再对比一下最新的气象传真图，看看预报是否与我们的观测一致。

pairs.title: 气象传真图分析
pairs.en: The ASAS chart just came in. Let's analyze the synoptic situation.
pairs.zh: 地面分析图刚传过来了。我们分析一下天气形势。

pairs.title: 气象传真图分析
pairs.en: There is a mature low pressure system at 50°N 170°W, with a cold front extending southward and a warm front eastward.
pairs.zh: 在北纬50度西经170度有一个成熟低压系统，冷锋向南延伸，暖锋向东延伸。

pairs.title: 气象传真图分析
pairs.en: The isobars are very tightly packed near the front. That means strong winds, possibly gale force.
pairs.zh: 锋面附近的等压线非常密集。这意味着强风，可能达到大风级别。

pairs.title: 气象传真图分析
pairs.en: Look at this ridge of high pressure building from the west. It should bring improving weather after the front passes.
pairs.zh: 看这边从西部发展的高压脊。在锋面过境后应该会带来好转的天气。

pairs.title: 气象传真图分析
pairs.en: What about the wave chart? How is the sea state expected?
pairs.zh: 波浪图怎么样？海况预计如何？

pairs.title: 气象传真图分析
pairs.en: The FWPN shows significant wave height of 5 to 6 meters in the frontal zone, with long period swell from the northwest.
pairs.zh: 波浪预报图显示锋面区域有效波高5到6米，有来自西北方向的长周期涌浪。

pairs.title: 气象传真图分析
pairs.en: Compare the forecast conditions along the available routes and prepare a revised passage plan for review.
pairs.zh: 比较各可选航线的预报海况，编制修订航次计划供审核。

pairs.title: 气象航线设计
pairs.en: Chief Officer, we need to plan our trans-Pacific route considering the seasonal weather patterns.
pairs.zh: 大副，我们需要考虑季节性天气模式来规划我们的跨太平洋航线。

pairs.title: 气象航线设计
pairs.en: According to the Routeing Charts for January, we should take the southern route to avoid the Aleutian low pressure systems.
pairs.zh: 根据一月份的航路设计图，我们应该走南线航线，避开阿留申低压系统。

pairs.title: 气象航线设计
pairs.en: The wind rose indicates prevailing northwesterly winds. Assess the relative wind and waves for each proposed course.
pairs.zh: 风玫瑰图显示盛行西北风，应评估各拟定航向上的相对风浪。

pairs.title: 气象航线设计
pairs.en: What about the Kuroshio Current? It flows northeastward here at 2 to 3 knots.
pairs.zh: 黑潮海流怎么样？它在这里以2到3节的速度向东北方向流动。

pairs.title: 气象航线设计
pairs.en: We can take advantage of the warm current on our way east to gain some speed and save fuel.
pairs.zh: 东行时可以借助这股暖流提高航速并节省燃油。

pairs.title: 气象航线设计
pairs.en: Also, check the ice limits for this season. We must stay well south of the ice edge.
pairs.zh: 另外，查一下本季的冰区界限。我们必须保持在冰区边缘以南足够远的安全距离。

pairs.title: 气象航线设计
pairs.en: Will prepare a preliminary route plan using the Routeing Charts and the latest weather forecast for review.
pairs.zh: 我会用航路设计图和最新天气预报准备好初步航线方案供审核。

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Harbor VTS, Harbor VTS, this is Blue Ocean on VHF channel 16. How do you read me?
pairs.zh: 港口交管，港口交管，这里是Blue Ocean轮，在VHF 16频道呼叫。收听情况如何？

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Blue Ocean, this is Harbor VTS. I read you loud and clear.
pairs.zh: Blue Ocean轮，这里是港口交管。收听清晰。

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Change to channel one-two and stand by.
pairs.zh: 请切换到12频道并守听。
pairs.speaker: VTS

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Changing to channel one-two. Standing by.
pairs.zh: 正在切换到12频道，保持守听。
pairs.speaker: Ship

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Please confirm your call sign, present position, course and speed.
pairs.zh: 请确认呼号、当前位置、航向和航速。
pairs.speaker: VTS

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Call sign ABCD. Position two nautical miles east of No. 3 buoy. Course 085 degrees, speed 10 knots.
pairs.zh: 呼号ABCD。船位在3号浮标以东2海里，航向085度，航速10节。

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Keep listening watch on channel one-two and channel one-six.
pairs.zh: 请在12频道和16频道保持守听。
pairs.speaker: VTS

pairs.title: VHF呼叫与频道切换
pairs.en: Roger. We will keep listening watch on channel one-two and channel one-six.
pairs.zh: 收到。我船将在12频道和16频道保持守听。
pairs.speaker: Ship

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: Harbor VTS, this is Blue Ocean entering the traffic separation scheme.
pairs.zh: 港口交管，这里是Blue Ocean轮，正进入分道通航制水域。

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: Report your last port, next port and ETA to the pilot station.
pairs.zh: 请报告上一港、下一港和到引航站的预计时间。
pairs.speaker: VTS

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: Last port Singapore, next port Ningbo. ETA pilot station one-four-zero-zero local time.
pairs.zh: 上一港新加坡，下一港宁波。预计当地时间14点到引航站。
pairs.speaker: Ship

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: Reduce speed to eight knots and keep to the starboard side of the channel.
pairs.zh: 减速到8节，靠航道右侧航行。
pairs.speaker: VTS

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: Reducing speed to eight knots and keeping to starboard side.
pairs.zh: 正在减速到8节，并靠右侧航行。
pairs.speaker: Ship

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: A crossing vessel is on your port bow. Keep clear and report when that vessel is abeam of you.
pairs.zh: 你船左舷首有一艘横越船。请让清，并在该船位于你船正横时报告。

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: We have the crossing vessel in sight and will keep clear.
pairs.zh: 我船已看到该横越船，将保持让清。
pairs.speaker: Ship

pairs.title: VTS报告与交通指令
pairs.en: Report any change of course or engine status immediately.
pairs.zh: 如航向或主机状态有变化，请立即报告。
pairs.speaker: VTS

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: Vessel on my starboard bow, this is Blue Ocean. What are your intentions?
pairs.zh: 本船右舷首的船舶，这里是Blue Ocean轮。你船意图是什么？

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: I intend to alter course to starboard and pass port to port.
pairs.zh: 我船准备向右转向，左舷对左舷通过。
pairs.speaker: Ship B

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: Agreed. I will maintain my course and speed until you are clear.
pairs.zh: 同意。我船保持航向航速，直到你船让清。
pairs.speaker: Ship A

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: Your CPA is too small. Please take early action.
pairs.zh: 你船最近会遇距离太小，请及早采取行动。
pairs.speaker: Ship A

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: I am reducing speed and altering course to starboard now.
pairs.zh: 我船正在减速并向右转向。
pairs.speaker: Ship B

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: We are approaching the anchorage and preparing both anchors.
pairs.zh: 我船正接近锚地，准备双锚。
pairs.speaker: Ship A

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: Let go starboard anchor in position three-six degrees one-two minutes north, one-two-two degrees zero-eight minutes east.
pairs.zh: 在北纬36度12分、东经122度08分位置抛右锚。
pairs.speaker: Ship A

pairs.title: 会遇避让与锚泊通信
pairs.en: Five shackles are in the water. The vessel is brought up and not dragging anchor.
pairs.zh: 入水5节锚链。船已锚住，没有走锚。
pairs.speaker: Ship A

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Chief Engineer, please show me the engine room logbook and oil record book.
pairs.zh: 轮机长，请出示机舱日志和油类记录簿。
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: The engine-room logbook is up to date. The Oil Record Book has been completed and signed in accordance with the applicable requirements.
pairs.zh: 机舱日志已及时填写。《油类记录簿》已按适用要求填写并签署。

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Is the oily water separator operational?
pairs.zh: 油水分离器工作正常吗？
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Yes. It was tested this morning, and the fifteen ppm alarm worked normally.
pairs.zh: 正常。今天早上测试过，15ppm报警工作正常。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Show me the emergency generator test record.
pairs.zh: 请给我看应急发电机测试记录。
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: The emergency generator was tested last week under load.
pairs.zh: 应急发电机上周进行了带负荷测试。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Can you demonstrate the emergency fire pump?
pairs.zh: 能演示一下应急消防泵吗？
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Yes. We will start it from the emergency fire pump room now.
pairs.zh: 可以。我们现在从应急消防泵间启动。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Are the quick closing valves tested regularly?
pairs.zh: 速闭阀是否定期测试？
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: PSC轮机检查问答
pairs.en: Yes. The test record is available, and the crew are familiar with the procedure.
pairs.zh: 是的。有测试记录，船员也熟悉操作程序。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: I found oil leakage near the purifier. Please rectify it before departure.
pairs.zh: 我在分油机附近发现漏油，请在开航前整改。
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: We have stopped the purifier and replaced the damaged gasket.
pairs.zh: 我们已停用分油机并更换损坏的垫片。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: The insulation on this exhaust pipe is missing.
pairs.zh: 这段排气管隔热层缺失。
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: We will renew the insulation and take photos as rectification evidence.
pairs.zh: 我们会更新隔热层，并拍照作为整改证明。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: The bilge high level alarm did not activate during the test.
pairs.zh: 舱底水高位报警在测试时没有动作。
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: The electrician is checking the sensor and alarm circuit now.
pairs.zh: 电机员正在检查传感器和报警线路。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: Please record the rectification in the maintenance log.
pairs.zh: 请把整改情况记录在维护日志中。
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: The defect has been rectified and recorded. Please re-inspect it.
pairs.zh: 缺陷已整改并记录，请复查。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: The equipment is now in good working order.
pairs.zh: 设备现在工作状态良好。
pairs.speaker: PSCO

pairs.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
pairs.en: Thank you. We will keep monitoring it during the voyage.
pairs.zh: 谢谢。航行期间我们会继续监控。
pairs.speaker: Chief Engineer
